{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7181173/83e31f2690c8703ec9f87d9562957c31f8b78865.jpg

Greetings Fellow Avatars!

To herald in 2021, the first release of the new year brings players of Shroud of the Avatar a robust offering of wonderful new content items, decorations, and other game updates. A new adventure scene has been been added, an extensive revamp of how gear patterns function is now live, a new decoration type that buffs players with magical attunement is now available, dragon eggs now drop as loot which can be crafted into Baby Dragon Conversationalists, and Public Cache Chests have received additional variations! For those wishing to participate in any community activities, new one-time and recurring community events have been announced! Also, be sure to also review the Players Guide and Known Issues list for additional information on recent changes and upcoming fixes. Now, let’s see what we have for you in this week’s edition of Update of the Avatar:

notes.title: Release 60 Patch Notes: November 21, 2018
notes.content:
November 21, 2018

Build Number 877 11:30 AM

Updates

 	Elemental and magic resist potions can now be added to combat bar.
 	Fix "Poison potion" reduced reagent use from subterfuge specialization.
 	Fix issue with Death Shield duration with Specialization.
 	Fix Cash register player vendor nameplates.
 	Fixed an issue where Magic Cancellation Field would incorrectly calculate attunement.
 	Fixed an issue with resource node highlighting for survey skill.
 	Northwest Blackblade Mountains - put Darkstarr corpions back in.
 	Fix bug that prevented picking up items via drag-and-drop in some cases.
 	Solace Bridge: fix issues with water.
 	Battle of Highvale: Updated some combat-related tutorial text to be skillset-agnostic.
 	Battle of Solace Bridge: Updated some combat-related tutorial text to be skillset-agnostic.
 	Brittany Fields - adjusted LOD settings on a bridge.
 	Ardoris: Emma the barmaid now has a response for "love."
 	Red Stone Dungeon - deleted erroneous geometry.
 	Fixes for various Unity warnings caused by switch to Unity 2018.2.
 	Sunless Barrens - extended water trigger to encompass entire seaside.
 	Aerie: The "Open Arms" now uses weapon shop decorations (instead of blacksmith decorations). Henry Steel's occupation is "weaponsmith" (instead of "blacksmith") but his inventory remains the same.
 	Solace Bridge: The quest from Emily in Soltown to find evidence of Quincy's fate can now be continued in both the Battle of Solace Bridge ("before") and Solace Bridge ("after") versions of the scene.
 	Matchmaking and multiplayer mode switching improvements

Known Issues

 	Crashes may occur when running the game in MacOS Mojave. A workaround is to launch the game with -force-glcore (which can be added to the Launch Arguments box in the launcher options)
 	Elysian Illumination no longer damages undead, and has a broken range for applying heals.
 	Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.
 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns cannot be placed on docks.
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.
 	Some virus programs with outdated libraries may attempt to quarantine essential game files, mistakenly identifying them as threats. This can have significant effects, including the client not starting at all. We recommend keeping antivirus programs updated frequently as they address problems. Workarounds include reinstalling and launching the client with the aggressive antivirus software disabled, or whitelisting the game directory in the antivirus list of exceptions.

notes.content:
October 30, 2018

Build Number 857 11:00AM

Updates

Updates

 	Removed giant pillars of blue smoke from Solace Bridge Outskirts.

 	Moved a floating axe in North Majestic Forest.
 	Fixed some floating props in Etceter Crag Mines.
 	Improved wall geometry in Bunker T.

 	Plugged several gaps of North Shattered Hills in geometry with rocks.

 	Moved rubble in South Fetid Swamp that was in the interior of structure
 	Moved a lamp off of a destructible crate in Hallowed Plains.
 	Toggled off doors in a house in Tenebris Harbor that contains combat.
 	Increased the interactive range on chandeliers in Brown Marble Foyers.
 	Fixed an issue with broken AI navigation in Verdantis Mines.
 	Fixed issues with batch agriculture skills not applying in certain situations.
 	Fixed an issue that would allow a player to create open spaces in dungeons where you could fall out of the world.

Known Issues

 	Avatars cannot stay seated at and play pianos.
 	Elysian Illumination no longer damages undead, and has a broken range for applying heals.

Workarounds include reinstalling and launching the client with the aggressive antivirus software disabled, or whitelisting the game directory in the antivirus list of exceptions.

notes.title: Q4 2018 Schedule Update
notes.content:
https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/Q42018Update.jpg
 
Greetings Avatars,

As 2018 comes to a close we can reflect on what an amazing year it has been! We moved out of Early Access in March and Collector’s Boxes shipped in Q3! As we have finished our Kickstarter promises we have been able to focus on polish and serious improvements to quality of life! The final quarter of 2018 is going to be amazing with Player Made Dungeons, Fishing Phase 2, Seasonal Content, and more polish!

PLEASE NOTE: The last two releases of the year (Nov/R60 and Dec/R61) will be very early in their respective months so that they are released well ahead of the US winter holidays (Thanksgiving and Christmas).

Q4 is just a warmup for 2019 which will be an amazing year for Shroud of the Avatar players! Crafting specializations (choose your effects!), Grandmaster Craftsman only effects, more loot improvements, more expansions to the fishing system, better boss fights and more! 2019 will of course culminate with Episode 2 which will have a new story, new lands, a revamp of the Quest and Journal system, a Theater System, Treasure Hunting with treasure maps that show up as loot, Item Affinity, Taming system expansions, Customizable NPCs, and expanded permissions for containers and doors!

Here are some Q4 Highlights:
 
RELEASE 59, October 25, 2018: Each harvest season, Novians warn their children to not go into the fields at night because of Pumpkin Head! The starting areas will be improved with the addition of a new tutorial focused area on the Isle of Storms.

https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/pumpkinhead.jpg

RELEASE 60, November 15, 2018: We will continue expansions to the fishing system. We will also dramatically increase the salvage rates for in-game patterns (common patterns will be almost 100%). Additionally we will continue systemic and game-wide upgrades to the quality and quantity of loot.

https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/LavaRod.jpg

RELEASE 61, December 13, 2018: Have you been naughty or nice? The Krampus doesn’t care! He and his captured minions will eat you either way! Also back slot items (cloaks, wings, backpacks, etc.) will now be able to have stats, enchantments, and masterworks associated with them. 
 
https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/ornatebackpack.jpg
 
and much, much more!
 
For all the details, please read the entire Q4 2018 Schedule Update post!
 
Have fun exploring New Britannia!

Build Number 825 10:30 AM

 	NPCs can now sit on toadstool chairs.

 	Elysian Illumination no longer damages undead, and has a broken range for applying heals.

 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.

 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.

Workarounds include reinstalling and launching the client with the aggressive antivirus software disabled, or whitelisting the game directory in the antivirus list of exceptions.

August 30, 2018

Build Number 823 4:00 PM

Updates

 	Added Eastmarch in-game map support.
 	Tier3 control point Skeletons were added.
 	Heraldry Tabard Leather Boots are no longer invisible on female avatars.
 	Avatars now correctly play the teleport animation and visual effects when going through lunar rifts.

notes.title: Release 55 Patch Notes: July 2, 2018
notes.content:
July 2, 2018

Build Number 800 11:00AM

Updates

 	Aerie overworld entrances are now named correctly.
 	All glowing portal teleporters in Halls of Artifice should now function properly.
 	You can now unlock the option to spawn into Highvale at the north archway entrance.
 	Fixed party member health/focus bars.
 	Players who wish to turn in their Ecology Survey to Eretria Moonglow in Aerie may now do so.
 	Zombie female no longer T-poses from the waist up.
 	Moved teleporter target in The Obsidian Trial to not have camera clip into rocks.
 	Made an improvement to Vivienne's "Bank Key" quest in Aerie to help ensure tasks clear properly.
 	Royal Gardener Title was added.
 	Moved treasure chest in Desert Encounter so lid doesn't clip into cliff.
 	Deleted floating plant in Norgard Fens.
 	Updated Umberjack's conversation in Broochash to improve responses when turning in a task.
 	Corrected rock Collison in East Vauban Foothills to avoid people floating on rocks.
 	Added Obsidian Boar Meat recipe to Butchery merchants.
 	Replaced unreachable bedrolls in Norgard Fens with furs.
 	Elven mages can again be looted.
 	Cloth simulation updated for cloaks.
 	Fixed an issue where the Reflection Quality value was not getting saved properly.
 	Fixed an issue with new pet foals not being able to be dismissed
 	Adding variations to tree chopping audio.

Known Issues

 	The client may default to full screen when the options menu is first used.
 	Linux clients may experience certain types of trees being rendered incorrectly
 	Elysian Illumination no longer damages undead, and has a broken range for applying heals.
 	The in-game map (M key shortcut) cannot be accessed on Linux clients.
 	Linux is using an older version of Unity until known performance issues can be addressed.
 	There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.
 	Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.
 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.
 	Some virus programs with outdated libraries may attempt to quarantine essential game files, mistakenly identifying them as threats. This can have significant effects, including the client not starting at all. We recommend keeping antivirus programs updated frequently as they address problems. Workarounds include reinstalling and launching the client with the aggressive antivirus software disabled, or whitelisting the game directory in the antivirus list of exceptions.


June 29, 2018

Build Number 799 9:00PM

Updates

 	Tree chopping sound now plays on every hit.
 	Added more chances for elf spellcasters to randomly spawn in Verdantis Mines.
 	Server logging updates.
 	Fixed a bug that caused players to be naked and missing inventory after leaving Isle of Storms the first time.
 	Clan of the Stag chest armor no longer incorrectly changes skin color.
 	Fixed icon for Luminous Atavist Robe.
 	The quest to deliver Kinsey’s report to Stanley in Soltown has been fixed.
 	Fixed chest mimics in Dragonbone Crypt.
 	Updated cursed skeletons in Soltown Catacombs to spawn dynamically.
 	Fixed a typo in the Skeleton Prince's dialogue in Soltown Catacombs.
 	Fixed Corpse Explosion not hitting any targets.
 	Crag Foothills and Port Phoenix no longer get stuck on loading.
 	Corrected date formatting used for the date column in vendor listings.
 	Frame rate performance updates in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Ignite Weapon VFX is now much less extreme while running.
 	Updated the exit to Blood Bayin K'rul.
 	Improved the ability for NPCs in Hills Encounter to climb on top of climbable rocks.
 	String light decorations can no longer be placed indoors.
 	Arrow recipe now outputs 500 arrows instead of 100.
 	The climbable rope on the main bridge in Verdantis Mines can now be selected from all angles.
 	Avatar feet no longer sink in rocks in Norgard Fens.
 	Bear Plaque/Trophy updates were made.
 	Added mud rock to cover up clipping paver in Norgard Fens.
 	Adjusted a staircase in Norgard Fens for a smoother walking transition to platforms.
 	Updated the tier markers in Ruined Keep and in Hidden Vale to reflect its new "Tier 10+" nature.
 	Updated a task name in Oracle Temple to clarify you need to speak with the Oracle and Arabella.
 	The Tome of Greatness in Shaminian Hills is now properly named.
 	Fixed an issue with stalactite trap in Verdantis Mines interfering with looting bodies.
 	Jumping during fireworks usage now correctly cancels the fireworks without displaying the effect.
 	White Sky Navy Helmet is now visible when worn.
 	Removed the compass labels from the exit compass discoveries in Storms Reach.
 	Reduced the range of audio on Tesla tower in Ardoris.
 	All ranged skills now return 100% experience when using Scrolls of Unlearning.

notes.title: Release 53 Patch Notes: April 27, 2018
notes.content:
Build Number 769 9:00PM

Updates

 	Fixed reversed portal labels in Artifice.
 	Fixed UI bug that caused broken items to be considered for masterworking/enchanting.
 	Fixed bug that caused the public vendor sell tab to be hard to click.
 	Fixed item effect tooltips and application.
 	Now preventing use of encoded text effects in party description of Looking for Group.
 	Fixed devotionals not applying any buffs.
 	Fixed an issue where targeted spells would incorrectly miss targets.
 	Fixed invisible Charlotte at Battle of Solace Bridge.
 	Fixed an issue where buffs from instruments were active while the player was not actively playing the instrument.
 	Defeating Fastus will now properly complete the quest from the Eastmarch caretakers to defeat him.
 	Fixed Glass-Roofed row houses to not have invisible interiors.
 	Damage absorption increased slightly for gear and skills along with a hard cap of 80%
 	Horatio in Highvale Outskirts will no longer continue to tell players to speak to Captain Burnes.
 	Four homes on specialty Crown Merchants are now also on the main Deeds merchant.
 	Added Cloth Map Tapestry to decoration Crown Merchant.
 	Fixed sky rotation in Tenebris Harbor.
 	One-handed militia guards in Tenebris Harbor will no longer try to hold torches with their missing hands.
 	Updated AI navigation in Tenebris Harbor.
 	Turned off the skill cap in Blood Bay and turned on the skill cap in Opalis.
 	The game will no longer patch itself while it is running.

Known Issues

 	Low client performance and bad framerates can influence resurrection timers, making them last longer than their intended duration.
 	Some virus programs with outdated libraries may attempt to quarantine essential game files, mistakenly identifying them as threats. This can have significant effects, including the client not starting at all. We recommend keeping antivirus programs updated frequently as they address problems. Workarounds include reinstalling and launching the client with the aggressive antivirus software disabled, or whitelisting the game directory in the antivirus list of exceptions.
 	Jumping behaviors may be blocked if the in-game avatar is colliding against scene objects.
 	Using “Follow” on other players will occasionally unleash randomly, requiring you to set “Follow” again.
 	Terrain in some scenes, including Player Owned Towns, may have an unusually hazy appearance.
 	Elysian Illumination no longer damages undead, and has a broken range for applying heals.
 	Companions (Offline Mode feature) dialogue continues to be worked on.
 	It’s possible to enter a state where weapon trails will be visible even with no weapon drawn. Relogging corrects this.
 	The in-game map (M key shortcut) cannot be accessed on Linux clients.
 	Linux is using an older version of Unity until known performance issues can be addressed.
 	There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.
 	Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.
 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

 	Fixed issues with Shipwrecked Haunted Pirate Galleon.

 	Fixed issues with quiver decoration interactivity.
 	Players can now destroy their coconuts.
 	Fixed colors for female shopkeeper.
 	All resource nodes in Bunker T should now be accessible without causing errors.

Known Issues

notes.title: Release 52 Patch Notes: April 3, 2018
notes.content:
Build Number 759 April 3, 2018 12:30PM

Updates

 	Increased the difficulty of critters in Blood Bay and their spawn rates.
 	Added a confirmation when enabling Peripheral Lighting.
 	Sivas Fel in Ardoris will give players that have dealt with Min Liang Tan a Necropolis Keystone if they failed to obtain one in the Tower of the Shuttered Eye.
 	Disabling 100% XP return on skill unlearning – these skills will now return 50% of the experience points used to train it.
 	Fixed an NPC in Blood Bay that was trying to perform an emote.
 	Fixed female avatar heraldry pieces that were missing blazons.
 	Fixed multiple issues with crafting tutorial quest highlighting.
 	Players who were stuck turning in Cyannis' report in Resolute may restart the quest by speaking with Godbert.
 	Fixed a bug that could cause players to be teleported to the front of their lots.
 	Fixed a bug that prevented earning experience from some dragon kills.
 	The tutorial task "Learn a new skill, then equip it" can now be completed - if you have this task, drop a skill on your combat bar to resolve it.
 	Fixed an issue that prevented messaging that a specific item is required to use a teleporter in the Lost Vale.
 	Lingering tasks for Broken Echoes quest in Jaanaford will automatically resolve upon completing the quest.
 	Lingering tasks for Vivienne's "bank key" quest in Aerie will automatically resolve upon completing the quest.
 	Bridget Helvig in Braemar should no longer offer her quest to find Veimor more than once.

Build Number 758 April 2, 2018 1:00PM

Updates

 	Fixed dyes on the lower portion of the Short Skirt Bodice.
 	Players in a party with Master Loot settings can again open chests on player property.
 	Unexploded Sacred Oracle Orbs of Obliteration can be found on recently slain Arch-Lapins. You monster.
 	Removed "EarlyAccess" text in /bug report.
 	Fixed delayed pet attacks
 	Fixed heraldry tabards missing blazons, having invisible pieces, and missing cloth simulation.
 	Fixed heraldry shield displaying colors too dark.

Known Issues

 	If you are experiencing performance issues, check that Peripheral Lighting is disabled in the options menu.
 	Elysian Illumination no longer damages undead, and has a broken range for applying heals.
 	Spellbinder’s Stance does not buff Spell Critical Chance as expected.
 	Companions (Offline Mode feature) dialogue continues to be worked on.
 	It’s possible to enter a state where weapon trails will be visible even with no weapon drawn. Relogging corrects this.
 	The in-game map (M key shortcut) cannot be accessed on Linux clients.
 	Linux is using an older version of Unity until known performance issues can be addressed.
 	Fire is visible when dead.
 	There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.
 	Juggle emotes do not properly sync hand/item movements in low performance environments.
 	Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.
 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Release 52 Patch Notes: March 27, 2018
notes.content:
Build Number 750 5:00PM

 	Additions to Crown Merchants.
 	Unresponsive NPC conversations corrected.
 	Matchmaking updates for when reloading into the same scene.

notes.title: Release 51 Patch Notes: February 28, 2018
notes.content:
Build Number 742 4:30PM

Updates

 	Fixed a bug that caused some recipes to display an incorrect skill level requirement.
 	Simone von Eglinger in Ardoris will now accept help from players.
 	Changing your title now updates the UI immediately.
 	Updates to PvP state are now reflected in the UI immediately.
 	Switching between training and maintaining multiple skills should now work more clearly.
 	Offline mode no longer has sieges on player owned towns.
 	Added support for buying emotes from Crown Merchants.
 	Environmental damage will no longer remove spawn protection.
 	Reducing the PvP damage bonus now that the damage balance has shifted closer to neutral.

Known Issues

 	The in-game map (M key shortcut) cannot be accessed on Linux clients.
 	Linux is using an older version of Unity until known performance issues can be addressed.
 	Fire is visible when dead.
 	There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.
 	Juggle emotes do not properly sync hand/item movements in low performance environments.
 	Crafting UI will not properly recognize Gold Ingots to fulfill Metal Ingot recipes.
 	Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.
 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)

February 26, 2018

Build Number 736 11:15AM

Updates

 	Fixed Frostgeist animation issue.
 	Fixed LOD issues with barbarian dragon armor.
 	Sunless Barrens in-game map created.
 	Verdantis Mines in-game map created.
 	Fixed rain falling inside of the Knight Founder Village player home.
 	The Primal Bear Headdress is now visible when worn.
 	The Clan of the Dragon Boots are no longer invisible when worn.
 	Fixed issue with female NPC skirts.
 	Some wall lights are now allowed as player town decorations.
 	Commoner NPC updates.
 	Frostgeists in Highvale Outskirts are now appearing correctly.

 	Rain emote SFX was updated.

 	The Bear Headdress no longer blinks along with female avatar eyes.
 	Sick emote liedown animation is now level with the ground.
 	South Drachvald Spur in-game map was created.
 	Text for Lost Vale exit to Novia discovery now reads 'Exit'.
 	Fixed a typo in Fortify Defenses.
 	Shield of Air and Shield of Ice no longer lose their attunement bonuses when zoning.

 	Blinding Shot will now add a parry debuff when specialized.
 	Disabling Shot will now add a dodge debuff when specialized.
 	Rapid Fire will now increase the effective skill and increase the chance for an additional arrow when specialized.

 	Forest Metropolis player owned town performance optimizations.
 	Fixed an issue where specialized Bolster Balance was not applying the Dexterity bonus.
 	Spiders no longer slide in place while dancing.
 	Fixed an issue where a player using Knockdowns would be knocked down instead of the intended target.

 	Player Vendors are no longer invisible.
 	Patch notes completed.

Known Issues

 	Trial users on the Path of Courage cannot currently re-enter Highvale.
 	The in-game map (M key shortcut) cannot be accessed on Linux clients.
 	Linux is using an older version of Unity until known performance issues can be addressed.
 	Fire is visible when dead.
 	It is possible for moving platforms to appear out of synchronization with others.
 	There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.
 	Juggle emotes do not properly sync hand/item movements in low performance environments.
 	Crafting UI will not properly recognize Gold Ingots to fulfill Metal Ingot recipes.
 	Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.
 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Release 50 Patch Notes: January 29, 2018
notes.content:
Build Number 725 11:00AM

Updates

 	Added missing fizzle chance effect to Lesser Staff.
 	Corrected display name for Highvale discovery on Novia.
 	Improved item sorting for quest items, they now sort to the top of lists in loot and quest delivery.
 	The text “Agro Boost” has been updated to “Aggro Boost”
 	Improved NPC pathing in Plains Encounter to help prevent leashing.
 	Fixed all phonographs and radios so that their lights are correctly off when placed and the item is turned off.
 	Removed movement delay after spawning.
 	When using magic on an enemy, the higher of the caster’s Dex or Int will now be used to counter the dodge chance of the target.
 	Load screen optimizations.
 	Preparing map data with Siege information.
 	World items only respawn in multiplayer matchmaking modes.
 	Updated AI pathing in Hills Encounter to correct mining ore on the edge of the map.
 	Micsere's task in Yew to gather ten ingots for him now completes upon giving him the ingots.
 	Performance optimization for compass updates in large towns.
 	Conversations will no longer fail if the player is too close to the NPC.
 	Fixes to quest pointers for a scout within Highvale.

Known Issues

 	It is possible to debuff enemies when out of reach due to environment positioning.
 	There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.
 	Juggle emotes do not properly sync hand/item movements in low performance environments.
 	Crafting UI will not properly recognize Gold Ingots to fulfill Metal Ingot recipes.
 	Quest NPCs will not accept inexact stacks of quest items. Items must be exact quantity requested at time of turn-in to be recognized as valid.
 	Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.
 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Release 50 Patch Notes: January 26, 2018
notes.content:
Build Number 723 4:30PM

Updates

 	PVP damage was increased by roughly a third to balance out new defensive options (no impact to PVE)
 	Deflect, Dodge, Glancing Blow, and Parry now all have at least a 30 second duration once proficiency is reached.
 	Magic that generates a partial hit will now say "...partially resisted..."
 	Performance improvement for player character rendering.
 	Added 250 arrows to the reward for Obsidian Elf Sniper quest in Highvale Outskirts.
 	Mackey is back from vacation in Etceter Crag Mines.
 	Bandits in Etceter Crag Mines will no longer stop talking after the first sentence.
 	Fixed Ice Gloves being the incorrect armor type.
 	Increased masterwork bonuses from 3 to 5 on Wayland Loop, Maple Band, and Thimble of Evelyn artifacts.
 	Hamstring damage will no longer be affected by a targets strength.
 	The NPC chat window background darkness was increased to make text more legible.
 	Dirt piles can no longer be destroyed with ranged attacks in South Drachvald Spur.
 	The distance allowed for digging up dirt piles has been increased.
 	Address verification on account page was updated for functionality.
 	Ballet Leotard no longer clips at the chest when dancing.

Known Issues

 	It is possible to debuff enemies when out of reach due to environment positioning.
 	There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.
 	Juggle emotes do not properly sync hand/item movements in low performance environments.
 	Crafting UI will not properly recognize Gold Ingots to fulfill Metal Ingot recipes.
 	Quest NPCs will not accept inexact stacks of quest items. Items must be exact quantity requested at time of turn-in to be recognized as valid.
 	Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.
 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.


Build Number 722 10:30AM

Updates

 	Fixed line-of-sight issues with numerous creature skills.
 	Another try at fixing Cloth Chest Armor making avatar skin too dark.
 	Fixed a bug that prevented the displayed weight of a container from updating when its contents changed.
 	Fixed incorrect texture tiling on Duke and Lord of the Manor islands in Tropical Island player owned towns.
 	Obsidian Scrolls of Unlearning will now also return 100% of experience.
 	Sitting players no longer appear odd to others loading into a scene.
 	Quest POI marker for turning in the bow to Horatio in Highvale Outskirts now goes away after completing.
 	Fixed an issue with Offhand Attack that caused VFX to appear on the top of the screen.
 	The Light spell will now follow the player more quickly when moving up and down.
 	Overworld creatures will now give chase.
 	Fixed death visuals for elementals.
 	Players are no longer launched into the skies in Sunless Barrens when near a certain location.
 	Optimization for "Good" quality mode that will increase frame rates significantly for GPU bound scenes.
 	Crooked Shank in-game map created.
 	Fixed not being able to loot dragons.
 	The Virtue Ice Skirt cloth simulation has been disabled on male avatars.
 	Some issues with the Ice Gown have been corrected.
 	Female peasant NPCs no longer teleport around a scene when trying to move.
 	Updated line-of-sight checks to ignore certain types of colliders.

Known Issues

 	Mackey in Etceter Crag Mines is not appearing which blocks that quest from completing.
 	It is possible to debuff enemies when out of reach due to environment positioning.
 	There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.
 	Juggle emotes do not properly sync hand/item movements in low performance environments.
 	Crafting UI will not properly recognize Gold Ingots to fulfill Metal Ingot recipes.
 	Quest NPCs will not accept inexact stacks of quest items. Items must be exact quantity requested at time of turn-in to be recognized as valid.
 	Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.
 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.

 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)

notes.title: Release 50 Patch Notes: January 25, 2018
notes.content:
Build Number 721 7:30PM

Updates

 	Fixed a bug that could prevent players from being able to load the game if they died in certain scenes.


Build Number 720 3:00PM

Updates

 	Some NPCs may not update their positions properly if playing in scenes with others.
 	Sheet music for equipped instruments can now be heard by remote clients.
 	Fixed elevators in Sequanna Colossus and Libris.
 	Female peasant NPC updates.
 	Yew optimizations.
 	Fixed wisps disappearing after death.
 	Fixed ladder placement in Sunless Barrens.
 	The last login date of guild members is now correct.
 	Female Avatar skin coloring was corrected.
 	Moved Novia wagon to other side of indistinct road near central teleporter signpost in Forest 02 player owned towns.
 	Numerous icon fixes.
 	Divided spawn groups in Nightshade Pass to improve occlusion performance.
 	Added address check if account address updated was the same but not confirmed.
 	Quest pointers are now complete for all stages of the main storyline.
 	Day of the Dead Mask eyes no longer pop out.
 	Added bear and boar dance animations.
 	Fixed quest pointers in two Resolute/Highvale quests.
 	Heal Creature will now only cast on pets.
 	Fixed display issues with ransom timer.
 	Fixed idle wisps trying to move to resource nodes.
 	All equipped items will now contribute to Max Resistance percent.
 	Update wisp death collider, allow corpse to remain.
 	Aldorn's amulet in Highvale can once again be found.
 	Quest compass indicators no longer lose data for NPCs at a distance.
 	Setup loose brick switches within each of the Kingsport Sewers prison cells, allowing players to escape justice.
 	Fixed charged attack interface persisting after scene changes.
 	Updated exit discovery names in South Drachvald Spur with compass directions.
 	Fixed a bug that caused the mouse cursor to not appear in the center of the screen when toggling modes.
 	Fixed an issue that caused stealthed players to disappear.
 	Moved down a large shard that was sticking out of the Pool of Destiny in Desolis Underground.
 	Fixed missing collision in Hallowed Plains.
 	Fixed bug that allowed players to attempt to batch craft using locked items which resulted in errors and red items.
 	Fixed AI healing using incorrect ranges, which fixes reported elemental healing issues.
 	Now showing lock icon for locked items in crafting and merchant interfaces.
 	Fixed an issue where a weapon could be the incorrect size.
 	Added feedback for attempting to use locked repair kits, dyes, and engraving kits.
 	Ensured Novia map painting is using the most up to date version of the art.
 	Fixed a stuck spot in Elysium Mines.
 	Fixed rock collision in Highvale Outskirts.
 	Crafting materials in the main backpack are now used before materials in sub-bags.
 	Players that finished Blood River Outskirts quests can see Alberic and use the keyword 'help' to remove leftover tasks.
 	Fixed issue with rune charging not working correctly when using the mouse with locked runes.
 	Wisps now have the correct death visuals for looting.
 	The quest data POIs in Blood River Outskirts now clear once they are completed.
 	Mage teleports now require line-of-sight.

Known Issues

 	Using emotes while seated may result in the avatar’s position shifting.
 	It is possible to debuff enemies when out of reach due to environment positioning.
 	There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.
 	Juggle emotes do not properly sync hand/item movements in low performance environments.

 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.

 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)

notes.title: Release 49 Patch Notes: December 20, 2017
notes.content:
Build Number 716 10:00AM

Updates

 	Fixed an issue in Sanctus Spine where the control point was not repeating its last wave.
 	Hamstring has had its damage over time effect moved to match Rend.
 	Rend Power and Duration item effects now also help Hamstring.
 	Trip and Rend have been added to the 100% unlearn experience return list.
 	The path forward to progressing in the Path of Courage quest beyond Brigid in Resolute is now clearer.
 	Flattened an area in grassland Player Owned Towns where decorations sunk into the ground.

Known Issues

 	POT Owners/Stewards are no longer able to place Wax Cylinders inside Broadcast Automated Phonographs
 	Quest NPCs will not accept inexact stacks of quest items. Items must be exact quantity requested at time of turn-in to be recognized as valid.
 	Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.
 	Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.
 	Some extreme resolution options are not possible due to an inability to scroll the video resolution list.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	Death Shield does not mitigate damage from critical hits
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	Hitching may occur when using UI windows like “Options” or “DeckBuilder”
 	Phonograph audio cannot be heard if approached while it is already playing.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.
 	When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Q1 2018 Schedule Update
notes.content:
https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/25353889_903961479766074_4274670404002978129_n.jpg?oh=148212458173f1ebabed386a875c3a12&oe=5A8DABE5

Greetings Avatars,

We are excited to announce a candidate launch date for Shroud of the Avatar! On Tuesday March 27, 2018 (Release 52), we are planning to launch out of Early Access!

So what does that mean exactly for a game that has been both persistent for over a year and been doing monthly releases for over 4 years? Well, for us it means that we are delivering the list of features, including physical goods, promised during the Kickstarter albeit with a few exceptions and/or replacements (see below). It also means that we are going to grow our community through marketing campaigns

As we have stated previously, we intend to publish quarterly schedule updates detailing our monthly releases and those monthly releases will continue. Even though the goals outlined in these schedules are likely to change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to periodically provide you with an updated roadmap.

Our priority continues to be to deliver new content to our backers regularly, so that you can give us feedback that will help us iteratively improve Shroud of the Avatar. This collaborative process continues to benefit the game, and often results in sweeping changes such as the recent polish passes to the user interface. As you have seen in previous releases, the flexibility inherent to this process means that we sometimes push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

Most recently we have been collaborating with our partner Travian to survey our backers on their experience with the game so we can correlate feedback scientifically with the metrics we are collecting in the game. Thank you everyone who has participated, your survey answers have helped guide our Top 10 priorities for launch and our Q1 schedule.

Check out the  Q1 2018 Post on the main website to see what's coming up!

notes.title: Release 48 Patch Notes: November 21, 2017
notes.content:
Build Number 702 3:30PM

Updates

 	The Cabalist Robe no longer causes performance issues when cloth simulation is turned on.
 	Decay will now apply to ghosts in the overworld map.

Known Issues

 	Halberd of the Sun auto-attacks will force a global cooldown timer on all abilities with every swing.
 	Some extreme resolution options are not possible due to an inability to scroll the video resolution list.
 	Elements of tree curtains used in many scenes will appear to be rendered black.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	The animation for "kicking something open" puts away weapons and torches.
 	Death Shield does not mitigate damage from critical hits
 	The crafting window does not have proper messaging to indicate when a tool is broken, and will simply say that there is no recipe found.
 	Dynamically spawned NPCs may have delayed spawn in scenes that are dense with player homes and decorations.
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	Hitching may occur when using UI windows like “Options” or “DeckBuilder”
 	Phonograph audio cannot be heard if approached while it is already playing.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.
 	The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.
 	When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.
 	When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.

 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.

 	Added rain collision to several ancient city modular prefabs, will prevent rain inside building in Highvale Outskirts and more.
 	Chaotic Feedback now has unique VFX instead of using Ice Shield.
 	Shield of Ice, Shield of Air, and Shield of Crystal VFX have been toned down a bit for better visibility in first-person mode.
 	Fixed an error with quest visuals in Artifice.
 	Leafy piles in Solace Forest and other maps no longer create graphical errors.
 	Fixed animation issues with batch sowing, watering, and harvesting.
 	Torn and Tattered Wedding Blouse no longer appears as a normal blouse on male avatars.
 	Falling for zero damage will no longer remove stealth.
 	Torn and Tattered Wedding Veil no longer clips through male avatar necks.
 	Blood River no longer has incorrect footsteps SFX while walking on the stone bridge.
 	Watcher spiders once again have scanning VFX.
 	Shield of Attraction and Shield of the Wicked King can now be masterworked.
 	Fixed Lord and Lady Langston in Solace Bridge Outskirts addressing the player when speaking together.
 	Fixed satyr and kobold underdwellers having improper animations.
 	Fixed an error in Kinsey's conversation in Solace Bridge Outskirts that blocked her from performing the Formal Love Salute emote.
 	Highvale Village fires now cull at better distances.
 	Fixed an error in Horatio's "hello" response in Highvale Outskirts that blocked him from performing the Formal Courage Salute emote.
 	New Braid hairstyle no longer is clipping through the Wealthy Merchant Hat.
 	No more rain inside the stone ruins of Highvale Outskirts.
 	Fixed many low-res issue with icons.
 	Locked Glyph stacking will now be properly interrupted when getting stunned or knocked down.

Known Issues

 	Some artifacts may be missing recent changes for repair, masterwork, or enchanting. Please report any of these edge cases for review and resolution.
 	Elements of tree curtains used in many scenes will appear to be rendered black.
 	Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)
 	The animation for "kicking something open" puts away weapons and torches.
 	Death Shield does not mitigate damage from critical hits
 	Combat resistances may not be applying as expected - notably against Fire Mages in The Rise
 	The crafting window does not have proper messaging to indicate when a tool is broken, and will simply say that there is no recipe found.
 	Dynamically spawned NPCs may have delayed spawn in scenes that are dense with player homes and decorations.
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.
 	Skill values will appear to carry over between accounts on the same client.
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	Hitching may occur when using UI windows like “Options” or “DeckBuilder”
 	Phonograph audio cannot be heard if approached while it is already playing.
 	Logging off will not clear previous party associations. UI will show previous party members.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.
 	The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.
 	When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.
 	When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.
 	Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Release 47 Patch Notes: October 30, 2017
notes.content:
Updates

 	Fixed an issue where the blacksmithing station colliders are rendered as white boxes while being placed as a decoration.
 	Fixed minor clipping with female hair through Nurse’s Hat.
 	Facial animation added to Satyr rig.
 	Fixed an issue where negative heals would not get applied at full health.
 	Fixed an issue that would cause the left arm to shake while casting certain skills.
 	Fixed an issue with "On Hit" enchantments that would significantly reduce the chance to hit.
 	Fixed interactive collider for post mounted mailboxes.
 	Bears are now less likely to move out of weapon range while fighting them.
 	Performance testing updates.
 	Added collision to prevent camera from popping out of ceiling in Epitaph.
 	Fixed the gate to the child's pen in Halls of Artifice so that the gate can be unlocked and opened once again.
 	When in free-mouse mode the reticle will now show while the right mouse button is held down.
 	Merchant window now closes when the merchant dies.
 	Setup entries for new scene scenarios in Kobold Expeditionary Camp.
 	Minor modifications to the resource gathering UI in response to player feedback.
 	Fixed pillars at wrong scale in Elads.
 	Fixed inaccessible ore nodes in Blackblade Foothills.
 	Merchants no longer exit conversation after using the "buy" keyword.
 	Removed rocks blocking entrance in Epitaph.
 	Fixed an issue with Horatio's conversation in Highvale Outskirts that was giving an error when talking about the new Formal Courage Salute emote.
 	Corrected several leashing range issues with non-combat NPCs in Highvale Outskirts.
 	Demig will now close his conversation when completing his quest in Demig's Battle Camp.
 	Fixed decorative brazier so it no longer causes fire damage.
 	Fixed an LOD issue with Midras Ruins on Novia overworld map.
 	Fixed bug that caused NPC chat bubbles to appear long after they said something.
 	Added audio mixers and their corresponding audio sources so that SFX will be affected by the master volume slider.
 	A Denis Loubet art piece was added to crown merchants.
 	Mace of Unsummoning now has the correct damage stats.

Known Issues

 	Some weapons may salvage for incorrect types of scrap.
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.
 	Sheet music played on instruments will cause background music to start skipping noticeably. Restarting the client may fix this.
 	Skill values will appear to carry over between accounts on the same client.
 	Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.
 	Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.
 	Hitching may occur when using UI windows like "Options" or "DeckBuilder"
 	Phonograph audio cannot be heard if approached while it is already playing.
 	Logging off will not clear previous party associations. UI will show previous party members.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Adventurer Levels, when viewed from the Character Sheet, do not properly update values based on equipment.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	Many rugs and Sigil decorations can be placed beneath existing pavers, making them inaccessible.
 	Kindred players can place deco Flyers on other players’ private Bulletin Boards
 	When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.
 	The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.
 	When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.
 	When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.
 	Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R47 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Q4 2017 Schedule Update
notes.content:
https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/q4-2017-1024x576.jpg

Greetings Avatars,

As we have stated previously, we intend to publish quarterly schedule updates for our monthly releases. Even though the goals outlined in these schedules are likely to change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to periodically provide you with an updated roadmap.

Our priority continues to be to deliver new content to our backers each and every month, so that you can give us feedback that will help us iteratively improve Shroud of the Avatar. This collaborative process continues to benefit the game, and often results in sweeping changes such as the upcoming addition of the Outskirts scenes. As you have seen in previous releases, the flexibility inherent to this process means that we sometimes push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

Top 10 Priorities: We keep a running list of our Top 10 priorities at all times that we use when building our schedule and prioritizing where to allocate our team’s resources. We often refer to it when making decisions about the project. While it has a VERY strong influence on what we work on at any given time, it does not mean that we only work on something that is on the list. It just means that if someone can assist with something that will help address an item on the list, then we will make sure they do that first before working on anything else. Sometimes team members cannot assist with anything on our top priorities, so they work on other tasks such as visual polish, combat balance, or content that helps us raise funds.

Until now we have only used this list internally and we have not shared it externally with you, our backers. However, we felt that as we approach launch we definitely should share this list, especially because our current Top 10 list consists of everything that we need to address BEFORE we are ready to launch.

Reduce Load Times: There are a lot of benefits to being a game that is divided up into multiple scenes, including everyone playing on one server and the ability to dynamically update scenes at will. However, being a scene-based game means that our load times MUST be mere seconds or the entire experience of playing the game is destroyed. Right now scene loads can still be over a minute on physical media drives (HDs) and up to 30 seconds even on solid state drives (SSDs). Reducing load times to seconds on both drive types is our number one goal for Q4 because the entire game experience depends on it.

Client Performance (FPS): Once we have reduced load times, we can focus on improving client performance. We will work on improving framerate, minimizing hitching, and lowering the game’s memory footprint.

Improved Reward Cycle: Right now, our reward cycle for play is completely unsatisfying. The loot is infrequent, not exciting, and requires multiple steps to gain a reward (ex. salvaging followed by crafting). We are going to add more immediately gratifying items (artifacts and gear with stats that can be salvaged for unique components). We are also going to slowly increase the amount of resources available in the world while carefully monitoring the game balance. Finally, we are going to add more unique quest rewards, especially items related to the virtues (ex. banners with virtue symbols).

....and more! Read the complete Q4 2017 Post on the main website.

notes.title: Release 45 Patch Notes: September 13, 2017
notes.content:
Fixed missing LOD meshes for ornate shogun crafting pavilion.
 	Offline reward delivery asset path bugs were corrected.
 	Helen Garriott art support for Children and Family Charities store sales.
 	Game client language is now set system default language, this setting can be changed in game options.
 	Updated Unity game engine to new patch version.
 	Plate chest armor is no longer missing when equipped.
 	Plate gauntlets are no longer mangled when equipped.

Known Issues

 	The equipable Shroud of the Avatar may display visual issues on both Male and Female avatars.
 	Equipment functionality breaks if armor is equipped that was contained within an equipable container that is also equipped at the same time. Examples include the Elite Elven Archer Quiver and the Ornate Backpack.
 	Enemies may continue to spin to face you despite being stunned/knocked down.
 	Quest Tasks that should update after looting a container may not progress if another player loots the container before you.
 	Squirrels and rabbits will not dance when instructed to do so.
 	Logging off will not clear previous party associations. UI will show previous party members.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	Adventurer Levels, when viewed from the Character Sheet, do not properly update values based on equipment.
 	Gawain, the wounded knight in the Battle of Highvale, will incorrectly stand up when spoken with.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	Many rugs and Sigil decorations can be placed beneath existing pavers, making them inaccessible.
 	Kindred players can place deco Flyers on other players’ private Bulletin Boards
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas. Reloading the scene appears to fix this in many cases.
 	When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.
 	The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.
 	When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.
 	When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.
 	Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R45 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

 	Moved "Dismiss" to the bottom of the list of pet commands.
 	Journeys End player owned town name was updated to fix letter case inconsistency for overworld tile loading.
 	Fix exceptions when moving decorations that contain an interactive.
 	Sheathed equipment no longer shows while using interactive objects.
 	Added decoration layer ceiling surface to the Elven Dome 2-story player house.
 	Adjusted the light intensity of Frosted Glass Chandelier.
 	Fixed an issue in South Broken Road where the exits were sending players to the wrong location in Novia.
 	Moved a cotton plant in South Celestial Wetlands outside of a poison field.
 	Fixed missing LOD meshes for Plate Leggings and Plate Boots.
 	The SyndCon 2017 cloak can no longer be rotated as a decoration.
 	Adjusted Carved Decorative Fountain collision to prevent players from getting stuck inside.
 	Further subdivided period-of-day scheduling on Service NPCs to ensure they only turn lights on during night periods and off during day periods.
 	When on the "Meet Lord Macsen in Castle Aerie" task, Lord Macsen in Aerie should now clear this task when you say "hello" " or tell him your name.
 	Removed an overworld tile template reference from hex at previous location of Ferig's Battle Camp.
 	Fixed a problem where items stacked on top of a wooden table decoration would get scaled smaller and smaller.
 	Norgard NPCs will now have different skin tones.
 	Adjusted stair collision in Kingsport NPC building.
 	Fixed the scale of the Master of the Mint painting.
 	Fixed scale of visuals in character sheet.
 	Nameplate health listing no longer flickers.
 	Moongate Travelers cloak updated.
 	Fixed cloth simulation on the Shroud of the Avatar.
 	Fixed gaps in doorways between the interior and exterior of certain NPC buildings.
 	Fixed door that was poking through ceiling underneath in an NPC building in Ardoris.
 	Fixed camera clipping into ceiling material in Wood and Plaster NPC structures.
 	Fixed an issue with Lord British Helmet losing durability.
 	Fixed an issue with not being able to enchant/masterwork the Miner's Helmet.
 	Planting Pots and Planting Barrels no longer render cubes while in decoration placement mode.
 	The lid of each sarcophagus once again will switch from open to closed, and closed to open, when you interact with it.
 	Nameplates on the overworld no longer flicker.
 	Added the border back to overworld names for better readability.
 	Fixed a material disappearing on a building roof in Vertas Pass.
 	Item icon fixes.
 	Leg equipment sorting polish.
 	Removed producer XP from daily bonus.
 	The male Tavern Customer decoration NPC will no longer appear invisible.
 	Teleporter arches throughout the Halls of Artifice now operate as expected.
 	The Courage Club Key now breaks after each use.
 	Fixed an issue where guards that provide Courage Club keys were not giving them after the first time.
 	Visual targeting indicator for fishing now uses a fixed mesh to allow rendering on water.
 	Fixed the barrier puzzle in Etceter Crag Mines so that the barrier goes down for all players.

 	Fixed the scale of the paper doll in the character sheet.
 	Friendly Gust spells no longer hit party members in PVP.
 	Dragon behaviors have been adjusted so that they will spend less time staying in the air.

Known Issues

 	Players may experience difficulty claiming rewards in Offline mode from accounts that are receiving Lord British Birthday Bash Telethon Rewards>
 	The equipable Shroud of the Avatar may display visual issues on both Male and Female avatars.

 	The Ornate Shogun Crafting Pavilion is missing visual LODs, causing the structure to appear invisible at a short distance away.

 	Squirrels and rabbits will not dance when instructed to do so.

 	Replaced some buggy trees in the Hidden Vale Plains Encounter map.

 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas. Reloading the scene appears to fix this in many cases.

 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R45 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.
