 	Sinar in Vertas now respects line-of-sight for conversations and barks.
 	Turned on daily experience bonus.
 	Fixed a stuck spot in Middle Downs.
 	Map UI window popup text no longer remains after mouse leaves the window.
 	Removed quest attract emote for Akiel von Strife in Ardoris.
 	Arabella no longer refers to Sequanna as the Titan of Truth.
 	Plugged a hole in the Colossus's hand in Oracle Colossus.
 	Covered up a seam in Blood River Outskirts river.
 	Disabled a tooltip from Pyramid Crypt in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Fixed collision on Blood River Outskirts pyramid stairs.
 	Fixed stretched terrain textures in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Fixed bad grass rendering in Deep Ravenswood.
 	Fixed a typo with Miriam Healy in Aerie.
 	Fixed a bug that caused the utility bar to be available immediately when a new character was created.
 	Raised terrain to alleviate a stuck spot in Ulfheim.
 	Fixed a stuck spot along the river in Ulfheim.
 	Fixed a stuck spot in Spectral Foothills.
 	Fixed a gap between stairs and wall in Knight Founder village home.
 	Fixed a stuck spot with climable vine in Midras Ruins.
 	Fixed a typo with Kiakis.
 	Fixed an item crashing into a wooden wall in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Fixed NPC schedule goal position errors in Resolute.
 	Fixed a typo with Anapa in Malice.
 	Fixed a stuck spot alongside bridge in Ardoris.
 	Ghosts no longer have generic "I don't understand you" responses in Confluence Chamber.
 	Fixed item name text color in tooltip.
 	Fixed the transparency rendering of ice wings decoration.
 	Fixed floating lantern lights in Malice.
 	Toggled off sarcophagus blocking entrance pipe to Kiln Cistern in Kiln.
 	Fixed a stuck spot in Hilt Exterior,
 	Changed decoration layers in Shogun Crafting Pavilions from exterior to interior.
 	Sigil Stone light beams no longer disappear when looking at them from above.
 	Fixed tree removal for plots with offset collision.
 	Adjusted arms on antique chairs to minimize clipping.
 	Fixed typo with Greedy Pilgrim in Xenos.
 	Raised terrain by the moongate in Isle of Storms to alleviate a stuck spot.
 	Updated the "Save Mildryd" quest in Resolute and Middle Downs to remove errors and improve responses.
 	Wilmer's display name will now correctly update when you first talk to him.
 	The troll stomp should now always play its animation.
 	Fixed a stuck spot in Xenos.
 	Upon being given the quest to meet with Lord Macsen in Aerie, the player will now also be given the compass discovery for Castle Aerie.
 	Smoothed some bumpy terrain in Tenebris Harbor.
 	Fixed target for ladder in Westend.
 	Fixed an issue where Forgotten Prisoner in The Epitaph would walk through cell door when player initiated conversation.
 	Fixed a floating Skrekk skull tier marker.
 	Fixed an issue where after placing a decoration it would look incorrect.
 	Player no longer gets stuck when playing a song while the Dig In skill is active.
 	Renamed magic trick emotes Mouthcoil and Flowerwand.
 	Added sitting versions of emotes yes, no, judgeyes, and judgeno.
 	Fixed an issue where you could not stack more than two cards together with the mouse.
 	Fixed an issue with ivy in an abandoned house in Middle Downs.
 	Fixed an issue where you could not play sheet music at stationary instruments.
 	Fixed a rock blocking players in Longfall Woods.
 	Fixed a fire trap damaging players before the trap is activated in Longfall Woods.
 	Fixed chat option in window selector drop-down menu.
 	Fixed a mismatched material on Burled Wood Round Table.
 	Increased font size on utility bar glyphs.
 	Increased font size on HUD health and focus bars.
 	Adjusted shooting auto-ballista in Middle Downs.
 	Game resolution no longer resets to maximum screen resolution in certain circumstances.
 	Shroud of the Avatar equipment VFX no longer "look like rain" when character is running.
 	Timed activators now have a random delay to avoid writing their states all in the same frame.
 	Rapid Fire can now get critical on hits after the first hit.
 	Ornate Tansu chest now interactive when placed as a decoration.
 	Removed some spike traps from a series in Ruins of Ravensmoor to create safe gaps between them.
 	Players again will incur decay on death.
 	Changed crafting recipe list text color to improve readability.

Known Issues

 	Quest Tasks that should update after looting a container may not progress if another player loots the container before you.
 	Logging off will not clear previous party associations. UI will show previous party members.
 	If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.
 	The avatar may appear too tall when viewed in the Character Sheet UI.
 	Adventurer Levels, when viewed from the Character Sheet, do not properly update values based on equipment.
 	Gawain, the wounded knight in the Battle of Highvale, will incorrectly stand up when spoken with.
 	Some NPC prefab mouths will not properly animate when talking.
 	Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.
 	Many rugs and Sigil decorations can be placed beneath existing pavers, making them inaccessible.
 	Kindred players can place deco Flyers on other players’ private Bulletin Boards
 	Some world items will be equipped immediately upon looting, replacing previous equipment.
 	Rapid Fire (Ranged) only crits on the first shot.
 	Auto-Ballista traps may trigger and fire at players through walls and barriers.
 	Wearable Cabalist Robes will stretch awkwardly when running
 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas. Reloading the scene appears to fix this in many cases.
 	When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.
 	Party members with active PvP flags will also be affected by a friendly-fire Gust spell.
 	The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.
 	When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.
 	When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.
 	Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.
 	Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar’s body
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R45 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Release 44 Patch Notes: August 1, 2017
notes.content:
Cloth equipment now scales correctly in the character sheet.
 	Fixed some bugs with supply bundles.
 	The Elven Elite Archer Quiver can now be placed as a decoration.
 	Ensured both dead guards in the burning inn of Battle of Solace Bridge have loot.
 	Players will no longer get betrothal bands from vigilantes in Blood River Outskirts after turning in a band to Paeon.
 	Moved both the monkey and bottle of wine to different spots in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Changed the conversation for the trainer inside the tree in the main elven camp of Blood River Outskirts.
 	Fixed an issue where a switch in Rhun Ruins wouldn't open a "trap" door.
 	Portals are now linked to audio sliders.
 	Village and Keep sized moondials now clear terrain when placed as decorations.
 	Giant crystals in Sequanna's crystal cage now draw correctly.
 	Fixed a bug that prevented changes to door permissions from being updated for remote players.
 	The Boletusporis Infans at the elven worship tree in Blood River Outskirts are once again dropping loot, but not weapons, thankfully.
 	Hephaestus in Artifice no longer tries to give his final reward twice.
 	Created new Short Assassin's Leggings to support length of outfit.
 	Alberic in Blood River Outskirts will once again reward helpful players of the refugees without the expectation of turning in the unrelated vigilante manifesto.
 	Added pre-placed light fixtures to Shogun City Ships.
 	Fixed exit volumes reporting they will take you into a siege even when it is completed.
 	Many objects Xenos for all objects that were suffering from the "Background View" Error.
 	Old Elven Heirlooms named “unknown item” should now be fixed.

Known Issues

 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas. Reloading the scene appears to fix this in many cases.
 	Mature agriculture plants may not appear in the correct visual state when placed back down from Magic Movers
 	Approaching the glowing doors in Halls of Artifice may leave a white overlay on the screen, changing maps or moving completely through the doorway should resolve this.
 	When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.
 	Party members with active PvP flags will also be affected by a friendly-fire Gust spell.
 	The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.
 	When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.
 	When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.
 	Indoor lights in the Duke Benefactor City Home will frequently appear as Exterior lights when placed.
 	Water Lot Island Keeps may experience difficulty placing decorations on open terrain. This is caused by a bug that visually removed trees from this terrain, but did not remove their collision.
 	Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.
 	When a Journal entry’s title is long and wraps to a new line, it may unexpectedly overlap the entry’s body text.
 	Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar's body
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R44 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Release 44 Patch Notes: July 28, 2017
notes.content:
Fixed broken item reference for sword in Celestis.
 	Set proper item type and fixed tooltip crash on Heart Of Sorrows.
 	Residents of Ardoris that have a title will continue to display their title after you learn their name.
 	Fixed an issue with the Ground Pound animation.
 	Missing wood strip component have returned.
 	The washed-out icon for "The Dirae Prophecy of Evard" item looks nicer now.
 	Fixed a typo in the phrase "Shroud of the Avatar" in the “Helpful Guide to Deck Building” book.
 	Extended entrance hallway in K'rul, adjusted the exit volume, and decreased the awareness range of spawners.
 	All auto-ballista now has far more precise firing capabilities!
 	Blast of Dread has had its range doubled to 20 meters.
 	The “Unknown Item” in Blood River Outskirts relating to Elven Heirlooms has be fixed.
 	Clockwork cats on patrol in K'rul can no longer get you at the spawn-in point.
 	Korabar's dialog in Skrekk has been made clearer when discussing past events in Valhold.
 	The Scepter of Dread should now be rotated during main hand usage.
 	Pinky finger while wearing Epic Cloth Gloves now looks correct.
 	Bows animate when firing and charging up again.
 	The slime stuck in a tree in Blood River Outskirts has been released and is now free to slime anyone that comes its way.
 	Fixes for Arabella armor.
 	FX for Puke emote no longer continues after the character has risen and is wiping his or her face.
 	Fixed carpentry merchant in Owl’s Head that was missing inventory.
 	Fixed animation hold pose for hands on two-handed blades.
 	Gus in Blood River Outskirts now explains more about the monkeys when a player clicks on the automaton monkey keyword.
 	The confluence chamber now has music.
 	Boleusporis Infans in Blood River Outskirts will no longer be carrying concealed weapons.
 	Now showing permissions on container window for containers placed on housing lots.
 	Fixed invisible stairs on Duke Founder City Water Home.
 	Applying a sparkly dye to Assassin Chest secondary color no longer affects the primary color.
 	Elven Elite Archer Quiver is becoming a backpack.
 	Doors are no longer disabled in arena basement.
 	Woman in Sequanna Colossus tent no longer sits on an invisible chair.
 	The Ornate Gazebo is no longer missing its icon.
 	Fixed offset wall tile in the Crypt of the Avatar.
 	Lenses and pages can be collected during the Path of the Oracle by everyone who is on the quest in multiplayer scenes.
 	Icon added for Shogun Ship City Home.
 	Fixed stats on the Shroud of the Avatar quest item.
 	Minor updates to user-interface elements.
 	VFX for breathing emotes now have the correct duration and no longer last too long.
 	Turning elf scalps in to Phineas in Blood River Outskirts has been refined.
 	Paeon in Blood River Outskirts no longer triggers a journal entry for Alberic.
 	The player-owned town “Ullr Ridge” has an updated location.
 	Improved the AI pathing in Jaanaford which will help the devotional caretakers access their shrine.
 	Fixed bug that prevented plants from appearing watered when they are watered.

 	Grannus now correctly plays his transformation animation.

 	Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas. Reloading the scene appears to fix this in many cases.

notes.title: Release 43 Patch Notes: July 5, 2017
notes.content:
Fixed some weapons appearing pink.
 	Fixed name inconsistency with Summoning Whistle Necklace recipe.
 	Robert Villines in Blood River, and Edvard in Solace Bridge, will now recognize if you have finished their quests.
 	Adjusted skeleton spawner groups in ruins in Sequanna.
 	Robert Villines no longer generates error messages during final conversation in Blood River Massacre.
 	Removed the collision from several troublesome roots in Brookside: that were making players stuck who tried to climb on them.
 	Added extra resurrection ankhs and chaos icons to Etceter Crag Mines.
 	Wealthy Merchant Boots no longer are A8clipping on avatars.
 	Fixed a bug that caused skill levels to be blank on the skill tree.
 	Athard in Demig's Battle Camp will now properly interrupt avatars visiting the camp.
 	Fixed Magical sparkling dye in secondary dye channel making the entire Epic Cloth outfit sparkle.
 	Players moving to crafting stations on lots should now operate smoother.
 	Demig in Demig's Battle Camp no longer force-closes conversation.
 	Failing to socket a gem no longer destroys the gem.
 	Ferig om Ferig's Battle Camp no longer force-closes conversation.
 	Added container scripts to renaissance bed when placed as a decoration.
 	Removed white glowing orbs from fire VFX in Highvale Village.
 	Corrected the overbright lighting on Character Creation Mirror interface.
 	Fixed a bug that caused the Nearby Players window to be shown instead of the PvP Stats window in PvP zones.
 	Fixed a stuck spot on the terrain in the Vigilante Camp in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Fixed a lighting issue in Savrenoc Stronghold.
 	Fixed a stuck spot in Verdantis Mines.
 	Fixed an error with a ladder in Vertas Pass.
 	Fixed low-health indicator appearing on first map load.
 	Restored moons and weather-based clouds to skies of Eastreach Gap, Southern Grunvald Barrens, Northern Grunvald Barrens, Savrenoc Timberland, and Brisach Maple Forest.
 	Updated water triggers in Graff Gem Mines to allow NPCs to pass through water.

Known Issues

 	Loading into scenes with previously opened/opening gates may display them in broken states, preventing players from using them.
 	The zombie emote does not produce the expected dance.
 	Players may experience combat lag when playing in scenes with others.
 	Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar's body
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	The dread artifact Heart of Sorrows is currently held awkwardly by avatars.
 	Attempting to use stealth skills in the vicinity of undead corpses may prevent the spell from working.
 	Using the /drink or /toast emotes will activate intoxication effects, which results in the Avatar being locked in a walking state for a period of time.
 	Tabbing between targets may select neutral NPCs. Be wary of nearby non-hostiles if using auto-attack while tabbing!
 	Linux: Adjusting shadows may resize the resolution of the game client.
 	Interrupting sheet music with another song may result in the music breaking for remote clients listening.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.
 	Avatars do not go back to idle animations after walking with an instrument being played.
 	The barrier in Etceter Crag Mines has been removed temporarily, there are issues with the primary puzzle triggering the removal.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R43 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Free Trial Test Starts Now! Runs From July 3-26
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the third test of our Free Trial Test system, running live now through July 26! This will be the longest test so far of the system so that we can gather even more data on uptake, drop-off, conversions, etc.

If you know anyone who would like to try the game for free, then send them to the Download page. These tests are invaluable for us in order to improve the New User Experience and the Free Trial System itself.

Free Trial Test access during the game’s current Early Access period allows you to play the entire game in any of the Online modes with a few key differences in game play:

Free Trial Test Current Time Period: July 3-26, 2017The term (Visitor) is appended to your Character NameCannot give items to other players via TradeCannot purchase nor sell items via Player Vendors nor Public VendorsNo ownership of property nor use of lot signsCannot interact with public chestsCannot move/interact with items on a plot even if they are given permissionsCannot flag as Open PVPCannot gain nor do they create any ransom items when they kill or are killed in PVP (in Open PVP zones)Character data may be deleted after Free Trial period is over if character is not upgraded to a paid accountItems purchased in the Add On Store cannot be accessed after the Free Trial Period is over unless you purchase Game AccessCannot play in Offline ModeCan only start on the Path of Love
You can still explore hundreds of scenes, talk with thousands of players, adventure through the opening quests, and gain experience and skills as you get used to the world of New Britannia!

If you wish to continue playing after the free trial concludes, you can obtain an Early Access account here.

For those in the Free Trial Test, we would love your feedback! We have opened up our Release Feedback Forums. If you have a constructive comment about this release that will help the game to improve, please post it there.

Also be sure to say hello in the New Player Forum!

Have fun, and thanks for trying out Shroud of the Avatar in Early Access!

notes.title: Release 43 Patch Notes: July 3, 2017
notes.content:
Incorrectly rotated skeleton in Dragon Bone Crypt has been corrected.
 	Phineas' documents in Blood River Outskirts were updated.
 	Fixed missing walls in the Great Hall in Resolute.
 	Fixed bug that caused target indicators to be invisible after character creation.

 	Fixed font size for party member location text.
 	Visual anomalies for the Headless Mask have been corrected.
 	Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented sheep or cows from appearing in Plans Encounter and Plains Road Encounter.
 	Fixed camera clipping issues in Graff Gem Mines.
 	Moved the player spawn-in location at the docks of Celestis away from a pile of boxes.
 	Fixed the Eye of Naturamans in Blood River Outskirts lack of decoration capabilities, it can now be proudly displayed to keep an eye on things.
 	Naturamans' skills in Blood River Outskirts were updated.
 	Holiday 2017 Cloak visual errors were corrected.
 	Corrected an issue where the gate near the entry point of Battle of Solace Bridge was controlled by switches that weren't active in the scene.
 	Flame and Thorn Sword VFX trails now better align with curved blades.
 	Removed all water from basins on devotionals.
 	Fixed inaccurate collision on trees in Deep Savrenoc Timberland.

notes.title: Release 43 Patch Notes: June 30, 2017
notes.content:
Charlotte's clothes and hair are no longer white.
 	Blood River Outskirts performance tuning.
 	Fixed clipping issues with the canvas cot bed.
 	Added discoveries in Boreas Colossus and replaced the final exit to Novia with a portal.
 	Added collision to pillars in Boreas Colossus on colossus platform and final portal platform.
 	Moved Samael in Crypt of the Avatar out of the entrance hallway where he would get trapped
 	Samael in Crypt of the Avatar initial greeting is now cleaner and less abrupt.
 	Owl's Head Lunar Rift now properly loops back to Isle of Storms.
 	Updated Phineas' conversation in Blood River Outskirts to reflect player poisoning elves.
 	Made some adjustments to the navigation in Celestis to better help NPCs travel.
 	In Blood River Outskirts, fixed a typo in Phineas' dialogue.
 	Light spell now produces more light.
 	Restored the connections to Isle of Storms for lunar rifts in Brittany, Brookside, Highvale, and Westend.
 	Changed some of Naturamans' spells in Blood River Outskirts.
 	The wayward smoke over the Fire Lotus Tavern in Owl's Head has been moved to be above its chimney.
 	Fixed transparency issues on the Oak Display Cabinets.
 	Adjusted culling range on the Ornate Kobold Backpack decoration.
 	Lunar Rift in Isle of Storms tutorial no longer has incorrect tooltips.
 	Fixed a small piece of wood sticking through a blanket on the renaissance bed.
 	Fixed an issue where standing on crates in a Solania Catacombs hallway would push the player's camera through the roof.
 	Blood River Outskirts now has a reward after poisoning elves.
 	Fixed incorrect icon for Flame Stained Glass Table Lamp.
 	Players no longer get a task to take the non-existent boat in Solace Bridge to Soltown in the non-tutorial version.
 	Fires in Blood River no longer have white orbs.
 	Increased the culling distance for fires in Blood River.
 	Set “ship smoke” emote to show pipe in hand.
 	Created sitting variations for the sneeze, burp, belch, and cough emotes.
 	Fixed room of black furniture in the Epitaph.
 	Altered the giant mushroom in Blood River Outskirts to stay stationary and still have ranged attacks.
 	Created a new weapon for the giant mushroom in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Adjusted Naturamans' skills and added a reward to Phieas in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Partial fix added for merchants moving during conversations while behind a counter.
 	Added blocking volumes to prevent escape from map in chess room of Boreas Colossus.
 	Performance optimization for North Majestic Forest.
 	Some weapons showed trails all the time, this has been corrected.
 	Fix for Oracle room door interruptions.
 	Assassin's Bracers now have the correct display name.
 	Added LODs to the Golden Ornate Greenhouse 4-Story Row House.
 	Healing Touch visual effects now move correctly with the avatar.
 	Fixed error with May-May's journal entry in Kiln.
 	Missing mailboxes throughout the world were updated.
 	The animatronic merchant in Soltown can again be used to purchase goods and services.
 	Fixed ladders in NPC watchtower in Blood River Outskirts that was causing players to fall and die.
 	Fixed summoned phoenix getting a fake copy at its point of origin.
 	Disabled distortion effect on Death Ray.
 	Removed tree growing out of tower in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Added tooltip text to teleport by statue in Boreas Colossus.
 	Changed owner of “Ordinis Mortis” player owned town.
 	Samael's wandering to heal Gawain in Highvale is no longer easily interruptible.
 	Fixed water elemental attack crash.
 	Mountain collision in Sequana Colossus updated.
 	Mideval tunic textures have been updated.
 	Decreased interact range on valve wheel in Kiln Cistern.
 	Corrected the scale of garlic nodes in Wyrmsands.
 	Improved distance leash on elf at back of tent in Battle of Highvale, and adjusted furniture and spawners in tent.
 	Alberic's dialogue in Blood River Outskirts went missing but has now returned.
 	A check was put in Marcus' dialogue in Blood River Outskirts to measure knowledge about the elves.
 	Made the spider lair trigger in Blood River Outskirts much bigger and added directions to the lair in Phineas' conversation and journal entry.
 	Added missing wood board recipes
 	Piercing breeze has been modified to be more effective against more targets and also had the buff for the target removed.
 	Removed collision volumes from equipable papers, scrolls, books, and quills.
 	Adjusted specular values on textures in the ancient environment assets.
 	Many white oak trees were updated to correct collision issues.
 	Deleted terrain and grass clipping onto stone structure in Ardoris.
 	Performance pass on Hallowed Plains.
 	Removed an extra sword in Celestis.
 	Trees on the Plains Road random encounter maps were updated to fix improper collision.
 	Added a little fence to ledge in Boreas Colossus.
 	Fixed crashes that can occur when using various skills such as Death Touch.
 	Fixed persistent buffs not loading correctly when starting the game and entering the first map.
 	Fixed bug that caused target indicators to be invisible after character creation.

Known Issues

 	Wearing a Cabalist Robe will disable visuals for equipped gloves/back equipment.
 	Equipment that changes the Avatar's body visuals (ring of the cuttlekin) may cause the avatar to appear pink and transparent.
 	Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar's body
 	It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.
 	The dread artifact Heart of Sorrows is currently held awkwardly by avatars.
 	Attempting to use stealth skills in the vicinity of undead corpses may prevent the spell from working.
 	Using the /drink or /toast emotes will activate intoxication effects, which results in the Avatar being locked in a walking state for a period of time.
 	Tabbing between targets may select neutral NPCs. Be wary of nearby non-hostiles if using auto-attack while tabbing!
 	Linux: Adjusting shadows may resize the resolution of the game client.
 	Interrupting sheet music with another song may result in the music breaking for remote clients listening.
 	Number keys do not activate hotbar skills if set to auto-hide from game settings.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.
 	Avatars do not go back to idle animations after walking with an instrument being played.
 	The barrier in Etceter Crag Mines has been removed temporarily, there are issues with the primary puzzle triggering the removal.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R43 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Release 43 Patch Notes: June 29, 2017
notes.content:
Build Number 617, 6PM

 	Magical sparkling dye in secondary dye channel no longer makes the entire Epic Cloth outfit sparkle.
 	Fixed a visual bug in Verdantis Shardfall.
 	Fixed grass poking through floorboards in Celestis.
 	Fixed animation bug with falling platforms.
 	Fixed an issue where the player could get locked into the swimming state preventing them from activating skills.
 	Fixed some shiny materials from the arctic castle set.
 	Added weapons and armor to the Brittany merchant for offline, removed recipes from this merchant.
 	Basement offline prices updated.
 	The “teleport to” UI now forces the cursor to be shown.
 	Summer Telethon 2017 balloons are now set up for physics.
 	Fixed stretching on all fur-mantled cloaks that stretched badly with emotes that raise arms.
 	Fixed typo in Ebon Dawn speech on death.
 	Added missing decoration surfaces in Twin Spire Lord of the Manor player home.
 	Fixed typo in generic crafting trainer conversation.
 	Light from smelting stations no longer causes beards to turn gray.
 	Fixed typo in Hyland Xaan conversation in Spite.
 	Fixed eye bulging during character customization.
 	Barry the Banker in Owl’s Head no longer refers to NPCs that have moved out of his building. They're dead to him now.
 	Fixed typo in Jacob Corey conversation.
 	Fixed wall decoration surface imperfections in the Knight Founder Lighthouse.
 	Lord Robinson in Resolute now sits on his designated throne as is fitting of a Lord Marshal.
 	Fixed second-floor stairwell asymmetry in Pristine Gothic Mansion.
 	Fixed firedancing outfits and coconut bra that changed skin tones.
 	Various localization corrections.
 	Can now learn Joseph Sepp's name in Jaanaford.
 	Removed blank letter from Resolute Sewers.
 	Fixed typo in /writescroll emote.
 	Fixed typo in Necropolis journal entry.
 	Fixed broken keyword hinting for these Ardoris NPCs: Chantik, Sarah, and Caroline Sjolund.
 	Jumping no longer clears the global cooldown for Rapid Fire.
 	Arabella's cloak is no longer stiff and stuck to her legs.
 	Flattened out the decoration version of augmented chainmail leggings.
 	Fixed ceiling collision in the Grand City Chateau.
 	Fixed broken keyword hinting for Sequanna in Malice.
 	Fixed bad ceiling decoration surface in the Lord of the Manor Keep.
 	Fixed bug that caused hidden tasks to reappear on the HUD when changing scenes.
 	Fixed levels-of-detail for the small bag decoration.
 	Bear trap damage area is off by default now.
 	Fixed lunar rift issues in Highvale.
 	Disabled cloth physics no longer breaks many capes, turning them into a single rigid body.
 	Fixed a bug that caused the top-right encumbrance icon to disappear when changing scenes.
 	Updated party member HUD nameplates when changing scenes.
 	Allowing italics on overworld location names.
 	Fix for terrain not casting shadows in Dracheninsel.
 	Resurrection timer now goes away if you change scenes while dead.
 	A hint now appears the first time you die, no matter where you may be.
 	Fixed standing stones near lunar rifts not showing up.
 	Lot permissions UI updated.
 	Initial states of banners are now set correctly.
 	Fixed collision error in Elad's lighthouse.
 	Patterns added for Assassin's armors.
 	Fixed missing carpentry recipes for Post Mailbox and Grand Piano.
 	Made the Ornate Kobold Backpack useable as a decoration.
 	Adjusted the height of the renaissance bed.
 	Added the correct collision mesh to Ornate Grand Piano.
 	Toned down physics simulation on held balloons.
 	Animated VFX on top of Tesla Towers are now visible at a distance.
 	Lava and cloud VFX on Novia map now draw correctly at a distance.
 	Added sitting versions for boo and clap emotes.
 	Adjusted particle cull distances on Estgard Waterfall.
 	Generated mail letters are now allowed to be traded, which allows these letters to be placed in chests.
 	Changed the icon for Eye of Naturamans in Blood River Outskirts to a (well used) spider eye icon.
 	Fixed "name" settings in various dialogues in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Created the "Eye of Naturamans" that the player may collect after defeating the anti-druid in Blood River Outskirts mushroom cave.
 	Updates for a handful of seated verisons of emotes.
 	Updated several blocking objects in Chillblain's Compendium of Pain and Suffering to improve NPC navigation.
 	Fixed an issue with texture on bridges in Desert and Forest Player Owned Town templates.
 	Fixed a typo in Corpion Poison.
 	Clarified the effect of the Fireflies spell.
 	Fixed a typo in Opportunity Strike.
 	Fixed missing water textures in Estgard.
 	Increased the collider radii for Daemon NPCs, and updated navigation data on many maps containing a Daemon.
 	Reduced size of overly large water lilies in the Soltown inlet area to ensure they don't clip through one another.
 	Replaced double fire trap in The Fall with one that works.
 	Set up drink and toast emotes for sitting.
 	Devotional buff areas have been reduced.
 	Shogun Three-Story Town Home deed updated to "Four-Story".
 	Fixed pivot position on the Ritter Shield.
 	Edvard's initial spawn path in Battle of Solace Bridge allowed him to walk through walls and the gate –his wandering rights have been revoked.
 	Fixed floating assets in Ardoris and smoothed some terrain.
 	Fixed unreachable bed in Blood River Outskirts, filled in empty space, added collisions to Mushrooms, and fixed stuck spots.
 	Smoothed out several terrain areas in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Fixed stuck spots and Chest Mimic acting strangely in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Fixed tree clipping wall and torch that was non-interactive in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Alberic and Elliana in Blood River Outskirts dialog was odd depending on who you met first, they now behave themselves.
 	Fixed steps in Harvest.
 	Multishot running animations adjusted.
 	Updated the Brittany Castle stand-in.
 	Removed two-way teleporter component from deliberately disabled ladder in Vertas Pass.
 	Blocked ladder visual in Vertas Pass to prevent player confusion over non-interactive ladder.
 	Unresolved tasks in Blood River Outskirts now flag to complete correctly.
 	The Blood River Outskirts Anti-druid will now come out to play.
 	More quests added to Blood River Outskirts map.
 	Fixed typos in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Leaving Blood River Outskirts now has a corrected auto-exit location.
 	Many bugs fixed in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Black Aeronaut Leggings texture no longer appears black.
 	Now allowing use of hotbar hotkeys while the hotbar is auto-hidden.
 	More UI elements have been localized.
 	Changed compass indicators to respect vertical distance for location and ankhs.
 	Created decoration versions for Obsidian War Hammer and Obsidian Spear.
 	Fixed collision in Elad’s lighthouse.
 	Fixed an issue with gems not being consumed during socketing.
 	The lava in Novia no longer flows the wrong way.
 	Lava in the Artifice forge now damages anyone who stands in it.
 	Fixed an issue with the lava in Artifice that made it scroll too fast.
 	Adjusted the player quantity from 8 to 64 in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Changed keyword Bloodriver to accept Blood River as an alternative in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Fixed another incident in Blood River Outskirts where Yliana thinks she's Eiliana.
 	Yliana in Blood River Outskirts has a new journal entry to reflect her name, rather than a copy of her sister Eiliana 's – we think there's a rivalry there.
 	Turned on ankh in Boreas Colossus that was toggled off temporarily.
 	Fixed a stuck spot in Boreas Colossus.
 	Fixed a bug preventing bears from patrolling in Boreas Colossus.
 	Epic Cloth Sparkle Dye has been fixed.
 	NPCs in Etceter that had been running overzealously during their "shift changes" will now be less enthusiastic to get to work or home.
 	Fixed an issue where Siege Guard Scouts in Forest and Hills Sieges weren't always offering the quest to kill cabalists.
 	All arched metal double doors in Halls of Artifice now have the proper open and close sounds.
 	Added mailboxes to the bank stalls in Jaanaford and Kiln.
 	Localization updates.
 	When entering a siege encounter while exiting or entering Virtue Oasis, players should now always be sent into a Forest Siege.
 	Quest items updated.
 	Added mailbox to bank in Soltown.
 	Lowered the terrain inside well in Sequana Colossus to see the water.
 	Ankhs now display further away.
 	Fixed typo in tooltip in Sequana Colossus.
 	Adjusted rocks and the ground in Sequana Colossus to hide missing texture.
 	Lowered grass and adjusted trees in Sequana Colossus.
 	Added blocking volume to prevent stuck spot in Isle of Storms.
 	Spice stall in Xenos updated.
 	Fishing now allowed in Sequana Colossus.
 	Adjusted collider on large tower in Vertas Pass so players can't run through it.
 	Removed visual seams in Isle of Storms.
 	Fixed sticky spot on stairs in Blood River Massacre.
 	Crash when using Ring of Fire fixed.
 	Fixed visual seam on water in Blood River Outskirts.
 	Walking on water in Blood River Outskirts has been banned.
 	Wizards Hat texture has been fixed.
 	Satyr guards in Xenos will now always tell you their proper name when asked.

 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R43 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.

 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Q3 2017 Schedule Update
notes.content:
//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/q3_2017_update_v3-1024x576.jpg

Greetings Avatars,

As we have stated previously, we intend to publish quarterly schedule updates for our monthly releases. Even though the goals outlined in these schedules are likely to change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to periodically provide you with an updated roadmap.

Our priority continues to be to deliver new content to our backers each and every month so that you can give us feedback that will help us iteratively improve Shroud of the Avatar. This collaborative process continues to benefit the game, and often results in sweeping changes such as the upcoming addition of the Outskirts scenes. As you have seen in previous releases, the flexibility inherent to this process means that we sometimes push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

Performance: One of our biggest priorities for the third quarter will be to improve performance. A significant portion of each release will be spent on improving client stability, framerate, memory usage, and load times.

New User Experience (NUE): Another large priority for the third quarter will continue to be about improving the new user experience. These efforts will include adding the final two Outskirts maps and polishing the User Interface.

Story Complete: Our goal is to complete the story no later than the end of Q3 (most of it will actually be done in R44 minus one Outskirts map), so story efforts in Q3 will be focused on finishing the Path of the Oracle (aka the finale) as well as polishing the paths of Truth and Courage (including adding side quests along those two paths), and refining the last two Outskirts map. Since the story will be complete in Q3, we plan to allow all players to make a one-time-only reset of the story status for their character (so they can start fresh with their current character) at some point during Q3.

To repeat what I said in the Q1 post:

“We believe that we have reached the final 20% of development before Commercial Release, at which point we will transition out of Early Access. The next two quarters will be the most exciting and challenging times for the project so far. This will be when we get the final features and content in the game and make the last important balance changes. The changes will be fast and furious, and they may occasionally be hard to understand when you become accustomed to the way things were before. Please trust that we firmly believe that every change we make is best for the long term health of the project.”

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

RELEASE 44, July 27, 2017 

 	Story: Polish will continue on the Path of the Oracle (aka the Finale) including work on the Destiny Pool and the Grannus Colossus (which is getting completely rebuilt). This will make the core of the story for Episode 1 complete and playable from beginning to end along all three paths (Truth, Love, and Courage). Blood River Outskirts, the new scene that players start in after Blood River Massacre, will get a polish pass. Also the first three cities along the Path of Truth (Aerie, Vertas, and Jaanaford) will get visual polish passes to better show off the fact that they are cities of Truth and to generally improve visuals (terrain, flora, etc.). Finally some adventure scenes in the northwest regions of Novia will be rebuilt from scratch, including Hallowed Plains.
//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Bloodriver-Outskirts-2-1024x553.jpg
 	Performance: Significant focus will continue to be made on performance including stability, framerate, memory, and load times.
 	Player Towns: Updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.
Rent: Property Owners will be able to add an additional "Tenant" permission for users of their lot and also set those permissions on doors. 
 	Combat: Avatars will be able to wield the Dread Artifacts (Heart of Sorrows, Bone Steel Crown, Scepter of Dread) for the first time and unleash their powers, if they dare. We will also continue our polish pass on all the visual effects related to combat. Additionally work will continue on overall combat balance.
//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_HeartSorrow-300x209.jpg
 	Character: We will begin creating Viking-inspired clothing for the NPCs in the Norgard and Verdantis areas of Novia to better define that region, including outfits for Royalty, Guards, Citizens, and Merchants.
 	Looking For Group: A tool to help players find a group to adventure with will appear in the game.
 	Economy: Loot on mid-level creatures will be adjusted to be more rewarding while still maintaining game balance.

RELEASE 45, August 31, 2017 

 	Story: Highvale Outskirts, a new scene that players start in after the Battle of Highvale Village, will come online for the first time. We will also focus on adding sidequests and polish to the Paths of Truth and Courage. Finally some adventure scenes in the northwest regions of Novia will be rebuilt from scratch, including Longfall Woods.
//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Highvale-Outskirts-1-1024x560.jpg
 	Performance: Significant focus will continue to be made on performance including stability, framerate, memory, and load times.
 	Single-Player Offline Combat Balance: We will adjust and balance combat for play in offline mode with companions.
 	Player Housing: Players will be able to claim property in Blood Bay, in our first Open PVP housing area. Additionally, updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.
 	Combat: We will continue to polish visual effects related to combat, and we will continue work on overall combat balance.
 	Character: At least one new creature will appear in the game as well as several new weapons.
 	Crafting: More recipes and more patterns in gear that is dropped from enemies will appear in game.
 	User Interface Polish: Time will be spent polishing the user interface.  This will include the ability to separate chat tabs into separate windows.

RELEASE 46, September 28, 2017

 	Story: Highvale Outskirts will get a polish pass and the Paths of Truth and Courage will keep growing with additional sidequests. We will also continue rebuilding adventure scenes in the northwest regions of Novia, including Crooked Shank.
 	Performance: Significant focus will continue to be made on performance including stability, framerate, memory, and load times.
 	Offline Spawning Rules: The rates and rules for how creatures and resources respawn will be adjusted to work differently in Offline mode so that while some areas (wilderness) can be “farmed” with regular respawns (just like in online mode), and other areas can be cleared/conquered (dungeons and story-related areas).
 	Crafting: Polish will be done on Agriculture and Fishing including the additions of new skills and functionality like Batch Planting. Additionally the ability to brew and consume Alcohol will come online.
 	Character: At least one new creature will appear in the game as well as several new weapons.
//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/SotA_Fishing_Trophies-300x205.jpg
 	Player Housing: Tools for Player Owned Town Owners will come online to assist with building and maintaining their towns includings a lawn mower. Updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.
 	Combat: We will continue our polish pass on all the visual effects related to combat and continue work on overall combat balance.

We continue to be incredibly thankful for the support we receive from this amazing community. While the funding you provide makes all of this possible, it pales in comparison with the faith you have in us, the feedback you provide us, and the content you are making for everyone to enjoy. We are humbly grateful, and we cannot wait to see you again in New Britannia!

Before I go, I wanted to include an excerpt from my original post about our Early Release Schedule that is important to set the framework for our ongoing schedule:

As a crowd funded and crowd sourced project, we feel it is incredibly important that we provide our backers with information and access well before game studios would normally do so in a traditional development model. Traditionally, the players are given information and access only after the development team has already decided exactly how things will be done, and at times, even after it has already been implemented. By the time the public normally has access to the product, there is usually no time to meaningfully react to the public feedback. Shroud of the Avatar is different than the traditional model, as we intend to offer our backers extremely early access to information and even the game itself.


Our strategy over the next few months is to provide you with focused and iterative releases of content. Your feedback during these releases will be critical to making the final product the best it can be, and we appreciate that you are all so willing to devote your time to helping us.


It is important to note that all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change.

Sincerely,
Starr Long
Executive Producer
Shroud of the Avatar

notes.title: Release 42 Patch Notes: May 31, 2017
notes.content:
Release 42
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 42! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 42 are available here.

May 31, 2017

Build Number 614, 10:30AM

Fixes

 	Ambient audio effects in South Naryad Pinelands have been fixed.
 	Audio effects in Ardoris Sewers have been fixed.
 	A Research Note in Oracle Colossus has had its text updated for spelling errors.
 	Constellations have been enabled in the Hidden Vale Overworld.
 	Broken doors have been removed from PvP Castle Arena (Teams) scenes.
 	Eyeballs will no longer bulge forward and clip through the lower eyelid when settings are at max.
 	Fixed Palisade Gates in Brittany Alleys.
 	Gaps between platforms in Opalis Ruins have been updated to allow for NPC AI to properly path across.
 	Conversations will now automatically close if the targeted NPC has a schedule change based on time of day.
 	The Braids hairstyle on male avatars have been improved to avoid clipping through certain armor types.
 	Skin color is now consistent when wearing Firedancer Leggings
 	Root will no longer cause AI leashing behaviors under rare conditions.
 	Labels for the exits in the Halls of Artifice have been corrected for the Lyceum and the Forge of Hephaestus.
 	Compass directions have been fixed for the following scenes: Ardoris Sewers, Blackblade Pass, Spectral Mines, Caverns of Skrekk, Valhold Palace, Elysium Mines, Brittany Sewers, Crypt of the Avatar, Verdantis Mines, K'rawl, Serpent's Spine Mines, Owl's Head Sewers, Kingsport Sewers, Solania Catacombs, The Fall, The Clink, Midmaer Passage, Kiln Cistern, and K'rul.
 	Khary will now reliably recognize when you are ready to move between Harvest and Estgard as part of the Path of Courage questline.
 	Equipment that alters skin tone (e.g. Ring of Cuttlekin) will no longer cause body parts to disappear completely.
 	Mail messages/letters can now be stored in chests/containers.
 	A mailbox has been added to the interior of the bank in Elad's Lighthouse.
 	Mailboxes in PoT Bank Buildings can now be accessed by residents; not only PoT Owners and Stewards
 	All letters generated by vendor activity now include the location of the vendor.
 	Extra doors blocking Decoration Shops have been removed, restoring access.
 	Resurrect Creature will no longer work to resurrect other players.
 	Resurrect Creature will now appropriately resurrect dead pets when targeting self.
 	Avitas's dialogue in Etceter will now clearly indicate what is needed for Passage, as part of the Path of Truth questline.
 	Edvard's dialogue in Battle of Solace Bridge will appropriately reference the journey to Solace Bridge Outskirts instead of Soltown.
 	A scavenger hunt letter container has been restored in Brittany Fields.
 	Audio for a number of runes have been fixed (Light, Dash, etc.)
 	Item Count/Limits for containers will now be visible while stored in a bank.
 	All generic merchants and trainers should now respond to the "buy" and "train" keywords respectively.
 	Players that killed the alpha wolf in Solace Bridge Outskirts but couldn't turn in the quest to Filmore the farmer should now be able to talk to him again to clear that task.
 	Cooldown time for Locked Decks will no longer be calculated on post-cast heat levels, which made them overly long.
 	The max cooldown penalty for Locked Deck heat is now capped at 2 seconds, a reduction.
 	Female Avatar eyes will now animate properly when lying down.

Known Issues

 	Interrupting sheet music with another song may result in the music breaking for remote clients listening.
 	Linux: Binding keys to the keypad’s period (.) key results in the key being bound to the keypad’s forward slash (/) key.
 	Linux: Playing on Fullscreen in desktop environments other than Ubuntu’s Unity (Gnome3, KDE, Cinnamon, etc.) may result in being unable to click on anything. If the client is started in windowed, then adjusted TO fullscreen, it may then work.
 	Grass will not always be cleared when using the roadway pavers, resulting in grass poking through. We are looking into a reliable solution to this issue.
 	Number keys do not activate hotbar skills if set to auto-hide from game settings.
 	Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.
 	Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.
 	Avatars do not go back to idle animations after walking with an instrument being played.
 	Backgrounds may remain blurry after leaving conversations if resolutions are on lower settings.
 	The barrier in Etceter Crag Mines has been removed temporarily, there are issues with the primary puzzle triggering the removal.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R42 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.

notes.title: Free Trial Test Starts Now! Runs Thru May 31st
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the third test of our Free Trial system, running live now through May 31! This will be the longest test so far of the system so that we can gather even more data on uptake, drop-off, conversions, etc.

If you know anyone who would like to try the game for free, then send them to the Download page. These tests are invaluable for us in order to improve the New User Experience and the Free Trial System itself.

Free Trial access during the game’s current Early Access period allows you to play the entire game in any of the Online modes with a few key differences in game play:

Free Trial Current Time Period: May 10-31, 2017The term (Visitor) is appended to your Character NameCannot give items to other players via TradeCannot purchase nor sell items via Player Vendors nor Public VendorsNo ownership of property nor use of lot signsCannot interact with public chestsCannot move/interact with items on a plot even if they are given permissionsCannot flag as Open PVPCannot gain nor do they create any ransom items when they kill or are killed in PVP (in Open PVP zones)Character data may be deleted after Free Trial period is over if character is not upgraded to a paid accountItems purchased in the Add On Store cannot be accessed after the Free Trial Period is over unless you purchase Game AccessCannot play in Offline ModeCan only start on the Path of Love
You can still explore hundreds of scenes, talk with thousands of players, adventure through the opening quests, and gain experience and skills as you get used to the world of New Britannia!

If you wish to continue playing after the free trial concludes, you can obtain an Early Access account here.

For those in the Free Trial, we would love your feedback! We have opened up our Release 41 Feedback Forums. If you have a constructive comment about this release that will help the game to improve, please post it there.

Also be sure to say hello in the New Player Forum!

Have fun, and thanks for trying out Shroud of the Avatar in Early Access!

notes.title: Release 41 Patch Notes: May 4, 2017
notes.content:
May the Fourth, 2017

Build Number 602, 12:30PM

Patch Notes:

 	Be they reset, renaming lot deeds will no longer create a blank entry.
 	With the Virtue Cloak equipped, it is no longer invisible on male avatars.
 	You can now adjust ocean audio SFX in Kingsport by using the volume sliders.
 	Compass indicator is now brighter.
 	Players can no longer enter Artifice via the waterways alongside the entrance.
 	Wind and water droplet sounds in Highvale are now linked to volume sliders.
 	Resurrect Creature no longer fails to resurrect pets.
 	Fixed various issues with certain skills not being able to hit anything.
 	Fixed an issue with Corpse Explosion where it would fail line of sight testing in certain situations.
 	Reduced the duration on the life attunement debuff from Tap Soul from 120 to 60 seconds.
 	Fixed the spell fizzle rate on Fireflies to match other Lunar spells.
 	Added six new PVP artifacts to loot in The Fall.
 	Updated stats on new Assassin's Blade artifact to be even more PVP focused.
 	Double clicking will no longer release your current target.
 	Some cloaks that appeared visually broken when worn are now fixed.

Known Issues:

 	The barrier in Etceter Crag Mines has been removed temporarily, there are issues with the primary puzzle triggering the removal.
 	Some enchantment effects trigger visually 100% of the time instead of the expected 5% rate.
 	Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.
 	Quick-keyword conversation selections do not work properly for localized text.
 	It is possible to get into a bad conversation state if attempting to enter a new conversation before the last conversation’s UI window fully closes.
 	Female avatar skin tones will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body.
 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R41 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.

notes.title: Release 41 Patch Notes: April 28, 2017
notes.content:
Build Number 595, 10:30AM

Patch Notes:

 	Fixed bug in Artifice where one of the final task list entries may not be cleared if done out of sequence.
 	Fixed several typos and missed responses in Artifice and Xenos.
 	Teleporter mages now have clickable answers in Eastreach Gap when asking whether or not you would like to pay their fee.
 	NPCs can no longer run through the gate in Verdantis mines.
 	Meteor Shower now requires a skill of 40 in Fire Flies.
 	Fixed an issue where pipe smoke VFX was disconnected while sitting.
 	Katana resting position now animates correctly.
 	A pass was made on player home and NPC building door sounds to connect proper audio mixers and correct spatial blending.
 	Cotton Cloth Chest Armor sleeves are back to green color.
 	Gave pewter plates a similar look to other pewter items.
 	Updated several chairs to help ensure NPCs sit properly within them.
 	Stag Hats are now brown instead of black.
 	Players can no longer get into a bad state by casting a fishing line while jumping.
 	Darkened skill tooltips background to make them more readable.
 	Streamlined font settings of skill tooltips for a more appealing aesthetic.
 	Restored collision to the fallen pillar over lava in Verdantis Mines.
 	Fixed NPCs improperly leashing when dropping in on NPCs from above.
 	Added a pit at the back of the prisoner cells in The Fall to allow players to suicide out of a stuck area if a friend cannot free them.
 	Steel correctly clears the "Gain passage to Xenos" task list entry when ferrying players to Xenos. (Players with this task list entry can remove it by purchasing passage to Xenos from Steel again.)
 	Many equippable decoration bugs were fixed.
 	Fixed Ant Cloak sorting with cloth torso armors.
 	Items equipped in the left hand will no longer be put away when sitting in a chair.
 	Tabs with quantity text on vendor tabs polished.
 	Localization errors corrected.
 	Fixed dividers being transparent in right-click menu for decoration permissions.
 	Darkened the crafting UI background for improved readability.
 	Improved some of the NPC conversations and journal entries in Solace Bridge Outskirts.
 	Fixed an issue with Resurrect Creature where it would not resurrect creatures.
 	Changed Resurrect Creature so experience is only applied when successfully resurrecting a creature.
 	Entrances into and within Artifice now work correctly.
 	Removed chair interest from bartender Margot in Jaanaford and assigned random patrol path with emotes.
 	Fixed a bug that prevented tamed creatures from being renamed.
 	Fixed scrolling overflow bug in Bank Vendor List for "Locate Player Vendor Items”.
 	Talking while having an offhand weapon equipped will no longer animate the left arm.
 	Baron's cloak (and other cloaks) now fit properly with bodice and yule bodice.
 	Players will no longer get quest credit in Solace Bridge Outskirts for killing an Alpha Wolf when they kill a Beta Wolf.
 	Fixed a sideways rug in Ardoris.
 	Cut back hostile spawners in immediate vicinity of Cyannis in Highvale.
 	Tweaked respawn rates and max populations for numerous spawn groups in Highvale.
 	The reticle now shows in the overworld.
 	Aether Aeronaut Helmet decorations no longer disappear when viewed at a distance.
 	Darkened the quit UI background.
 	Harvest town crier once again accepts mail and will reset your current task list.
 	Emma the barmaid in Soltown will no longer accept Japeth's poem more than once.
 	The waist of both the Long and Short Skirt Bodices no longer have an uneven edge along the waist.
 	Buff and debuff timer overlay is now visible.
 	Fixed a typo in Ackerley of Solace Bridge Outskirts conversation.
 	The Tavern Counter with Gate decoration can now have other decorations placed on it.
 	Players who arrive in Xenos from booking passage with Cpt. Steel in Etceter now properly appear at the docks.
 	Interactive teleporters no longer send players to random locations.
 	Adjusted spawners and patrol paths in Ardoris for Issan the Guard.
 	Players and NPCs in Xenos should now sit in the proper locations on the benches within the Hall of Boreas.
 	Modified keys on the piano and lute no longer cause notes to repeat.
 	The damage volume in the "poison room" of Chillblain's has been adjusted to only affect those standing in the water.
 	All fountain decorations now require a full surface for placement.
 	Fixed a visual bug on "Buy More Slots" button in bank UI.
 	Improved responses from Filmore in Solace Bridge Outskirts to "hello", and added one for "undead."
 	Adjusted where the beta wolves walk in Solace Bridge Outskirts to help keep them attackable.
 	Added additional "hello" dialogue for Lord Langston in Solace Bridge Outskirts that relates to whether or not you have the painting he seeks.
 	Chest gear with mend effect will now only work 1 in 20 times as designed.
 	Giant arrows in Ardoris have been removed.

Known Issues:

notes.title: The Magnificent Trophy Room Contest Begins!
notes.content:
Get your houses ready for the most intense contest yet this year! Over the next several weeks, you will have the fun opportunity to show off your hunting heroism, crafting coordination, and trophy triumphs in this new three part contest kicking off today.

PART 1: Hunt down a creature, kill another player (to get their skull), or catch a fish!

PART 2: Craft the trophy from that creature (human skulls come as-is, no preparation needed…)

PART 3: Display your trophy triumphs in a single room of a house you have access too!​

WINNERS & PRIZES

Prizes will be awarded on a tier basis:
1st Place: 100 in-game COTOs and three developer skulls of your choice.2nd Place: 50 COTOs and two developer skulls of your choice.Two Runner-ups: 25 COTOs and one developer skull of your choice.All valid entries will receive a custom title in-game (exact title yet to be decided… community suggestions are welcome! Should refer to the contest in some way, and not be a title that we would use for other hunting/trophy purposes.)
As we receive contest submissions, they will be announced in the forums and on social with eventually a gallery of all submissions put together. Winners will be announced at the start of the Summer Telethon on May 31 around 12:30pm CT.

Read more about the contest and submit your entry in the forums!

notes.title: Free Trial Test Starts Now! From April 6-10
notes.content:
We are excited to open up our second test of the Free Trial System! This latest trial begins now and will end on April 10. If you know anyone who would try the game for free, please send them to the Download Page. These tests are invaluable for us in order to improve the New User Experience (NUE) and the Free Trial System itself.

Free Trial access during the game’s current Early Access period allows you to play the entire game in any of the Online modes with a few key differences in game play:
Free Trial Current Time Period: April 6-10, 2017The term (Visitor) is appended to your Character NameCannot give items to other players via TradeCannot purchase nor sell items via Player Vendors nor Public VendorsNo ownership of property nor use of lot signsCannot interact with public chestsCannot move/interact with items on a plot even if they are given permissionsCannot flag as Open PVPCannot gain nor do they create any ransom items when they kill or are killed in PVP (in Open PVP zones)Character data may be deleted after Free Trial period is over if character is not upgraded to a paid accountItems purchased in the Add On Store cannot be accessed after the Free Trial Period is over unless you purchase Game AccessCannot play in Offline Mode
You can still explore hundreds of scenes, talk with thousands of players, adventure through the opening quests, and gain experience and skills as you get used to the world of New Britannia!

If you wish to continue playing after the free trial concludes, you can obtain an Early Access account here.

For those in the Free Trial, we would love your feedback! We have opened up our Release 40 Feedback Forums. If you have a constructive comment about this release that will help the game to improve, please post it there.

Also be sure to say hello in the New Player Forum!

Have fun, and thanks for trying out Shroud of the Avatar in Early Access!

notes.title: Release 40 Patch Notes: April 7, 2017
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 40! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 40 are available here.

April 7, 2017

Build Number 587, 6:00PM

Fixes:

 	Player Town “Home Shop” decoration building is no longer invisible.
 	Visual updates to the Wood Duck.
 	Fixed various server and client exceptions.
 	Server logging messages were added.

Known Issues:

 	Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.
 	Not all items listed in R40 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Cover System is not applying to magic spells
 	Some of the Obsidian Cabalist abilities are still placeholder
 	Some NPCs are not holding items correctly (mugs, brooms, etc.)
 	Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	A new Conversation interface has been introduced and may introduce various issues with resolving quests and talking to NPCs.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Lot Deeds cannot be purchased in Offline Mode
 	Some UI text is not wrapping correctly
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies
 	Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.
 	The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.
 	Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.
 	Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body
 	ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT
