notes.title: Q2 2017 Schedule Update
notes.content:
//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/q2_update_header-1024x576.jpg

Greetings Avatars,

As we have stated previously, we intend to publish quarterly schedule updates for our monthly releases. Even though the goals outlined in these schedules are likely to change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to periodically provide you with an updated roadmap.

Our priority continues to be to deliver new content to our backers each and every month so that you can give us feedback that will help us iteratively improve Shroud of the Avatar. This collaborative process continues to benefit the game, and often results in sweeping changes such as the upcoming addition of the Outskirts scenes. As you have seen in previous releases, the flexibility inherent to this process means that we sometimes push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

New User Experience (NUE): A large priority for the second quarter is going to be improving the new user experience. For several years now, our backers have been providing us feedback that the first few hours of our game have several major issues. Those issues include too many loading screens, scenes that are too small, overloading the user with too many options, and starting towns that include player housing/vendors. As we shift our focus to improving the New User Experience, and as we are able to measure new player progress during events such as our recent free trial, we realize that we must address these issues sooner rather than later.

As we announced during the Spring Telethon, one of our solutions to these issues is to add three new maps to the game that we are calling "Outskirts." These scenes will be very close to the three starting scenes, and players will go directly there after finishing those starting scenes. Outskirts will be very large scenes, similar in scope to some of the recently added big scenes like Blood Bay. Each Outskirt scene will have a small outpost that will include some shopkeepers, trainers, crafting stations, and a few quest givers (and no player housing!). The scenes will also include plenty of adventuring areas (forests, ruins, bandit camps, etc.). The large scale of the Outskirts, as well as the variety of experiences and services that they provide, will allow new players to base themselves in a single scene for adventuring and resupply for their first couple of hours of gameplay without needing to go through multiple loading screens or needing to use the Overworld.

In addition to Outskirts, we plan to improve the new user experience by delaying more advanced features until later in the game (which we began doing in Release 40). We also plan to implement Contextual Help, Improved Tutorial Systems, and a Polished Skill Training Interface.//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Solace-Bridge-Outskirts-2-1024x530.jpg

Polish: In addition to the focus on the first few hours of gameplay, Q2 will include a lot of work on polishing the overall experience of playing Shroud of the Avatar. A large focus of this work will be on performance and stability, which is why you may see fewer new features than in previous quarters as you scan the list below. However, we will be adding some new features that are aimed at polishing the game. These include Mail, Looking for Group, and a Raid System. Additionally, continual passes will be made each release to address overall balance issues, especially in the first few hours of game play.

Story Complete: Our goal is to complete the story by Release 44 (July), so story efforts in Q2 will be focused on bringing the Paths of Truth and Courage to a playable and polished state. We also plan to unveil the game’s Finale. Since the story will be complete in R44, we plan to allow all players to make a one-time-only reset of the story status for their character (so they can start fresh with their current character) in Release 44 (July).

To repeat what I said in the Q1 post:

“We believe that we have reached the final 20% of development before Commercial Release, at which point we will transition out of Early Access. The next two quarters will be the most exciting and challenging times for the project so far. This will be when we get the final features and content in the game and make the last important balance changes. The changes will be fast and furious, and they may occasionally be hard to understand when you become accustomed to the way things were before. Please trust that we firmly believe that every change we make is best for the long term health of the project.”

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

RELEASE 41, April 27, 2017

 	Story: We will begin polishing the Path of Truth with the Dungeon of Artifice coming online for the first time. We will also polish visuals of the final sequence with the Titan Grannus in the Path of Courage. The incidental NPCs and side quests along the Path of Courage will also be worked on in locations like Estgard and Harvest. Verdantis Mines and the Kas Ruins scenes will both be uncloned. The Fall, a new PvP dungeon underneath Blood Bay, will appear in the game. Solace Bridge Outskirts, a new scene that players start in after the Battle of Solace Bridge will come online for the first time.//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Hall-of-Wealth-Without-Limits_03a-1024x551.jpg
 	Performance: Significant focus will be made on performance this release with emphasis on stability, framerate, memory, and load times.
 	Player Towns & Player Housing: Updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game. Additionally Shields, Tools, and Helmets will become place-able as decorations.
 	Combat: We will continue our polish pass on all the visual effects related to combat as well as make major improvements to the new user experience with combat.
 	Character: The Titan Grannus will get his own unique art for the first time. Wounded variations of our guards and soldiers will appear in game. We will also be polishing the medieval peasants.
 	Contextual Help: A contextual help system will come online that allows players to hover over content (interface elements, items, etc.) in the game and get information about it.
 	Game Balance: Major efforts will be devoted towards game balance.
 	Crafting: More recipes and more patterns in gear that is dropped from enemies.

RELEASE 42, May 25, 2017

 	Story: We will do final polish on the Path of Truth including incidental NPCs and side quests in areas like Xenos and Etceter. We will polish visuals of the final sequence with Titan Boreas in the Path of Truth. Highvale Outskirts, a new scene that players start in after the Battle of Highvale Village, will come online for the first time.//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Xenos-Subpost-V_14-1024x549.jpg
 	Player Housing: Updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.
 	Combat: We will continue our polish pass on all the visual effects related to combat.
 	Character: The Titans Sequanna and Boreas, as well as Arabella, will get their own unique visuals. We will also do some polish work on Player Customization.
 	Crafting: More recipes and more patterns in gear that is dropped from enemies.
 	Raid System: Tools will come online for large groups, and groups of groups, to go on adventures together.
 	Looking For Group: A tool to help players find a group to adventure with will appear in the game.

RELEASE 43, June 29, 2017

 	Story: Polish will begin on the Finale of the plot including work on the Destiny Pool and the Oracle Chamber. Blood River Outskirts, a new scene that players start in after Blood River Massacre, will come online for the first time.//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/New-Desolis-19-Pool-of-Destiny-02-1024x554.jpg
 	Character: The Oracle herself will appear for the first time in the game as will the Shroud of the Avatar. We will be doing polish work on various creatures in the game, such as the Troll. We will also begin creating Viking-inspired clothing for the NPCs in the Norgard and Verdantis areas of Novia to better define that region, including outfits for Royalty, Guards, Citizens, and Merchants.
 	Performance: Significant focus will be made on performance this release with emphasis on stability, framerate and load times.
 	Bug Fixes and Game Balance: Much of this release will be spent on fixing bugs and balancing game systems.
 	Mail: Players will be able to send mail to each other through an in-game interface.
 	Offline Combat and Economy Balance: A pass will be made through the game to adjust combat balance for play in offline mode with companions. Additionally, the economy in offline mode will be tuned to be better balanced for single-player. For instance, NPC merchants will buy player-crafted items at a profit to the player. Also, pledge and Add-On Store items will be available from NPC merchants for purchase with in-game gold.
 	Player Housing: Updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game. Additionally the ability to rent rooms in a player home will start to become available to homeowners.

We continue to be incredibly thankful for the support we receive from this amazing community. While the funding you provide makes all of this possible, it pales in comparison with the faith you have in us, the feedback you provide us, and the content you are making for everyone to enjoy. We are humbly grateful, and we cannot wait to see you again in New Britannia!

Before I go, I wanted to include an excerpt from my original post about our Early Release Schedule that is important to set the framework for our ongoing schedule:

"As a crowd funded and crowd sourced project, we feel it is incredibly important that we provide our backers with information and access well before game studios would normally do so in a traditional development model. Traditionally, the players are given information and access only after the development team has already decided exactly how things will be done, and at times, even after it has already been implemented. By the time the public normally has access to the product, there is usually no time to meaningfully react to the public feedback.
Shroud of the Avatar is different than the traditional model, as we intend to offer our backers extremely early access to information and even the game itself. With that said, we also want to be very careful that we only provide access to portions of the game when they are ready for a wider range of feedback. If we can play it internally and we know it is not ready, then there is nothing to be gained by having a wider audience come to the same conclusion. In fact, it could be quite damaging to do so.

Our strategy over the next few months is to provide you with focused and iterative releases of content. Your feedback during these releases will be critical to making the final product the best it can be, and we appreciate that you are all so willing to devote your time to helping us. After each release we will review the results and reevaluate the plan including the duration of availability of each release.


It is important to repeat that all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change.​"

Sincerely,
Starr Long
Executive Producer
Shroud of the Avatar

notes.title: Release 40 Patch Notes: March 30, 2017
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 40! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 40 are available here.

March 30, 2017

Build Number 577, 1:15PM


Fixes:

 	Male and female Cabalist wearable robes are now fitted correctly.
 	Eye bulge clipping during character creation has been fixed.
 	Missing collision on palisade walls in Kingsport has been added.
 	High-level creature weapon loot added.
 	Kobold Champion in Skrekk Test of Courage instance now displays the proper nameplate.
 	Kobolds in Skrekk should now make some noise.
 	Adjusted collision for elven greenhouse to allow for more lenient decoration placement inside.
 	Ghost Corpion is transparent again.
 	Fixed a bug that caused hints and help messages in the chat window to appear in the wrong order.
 	Fixed a decoration wall surface in Stone 2-story Keep w/ Corner Turret village home, decorations no longer go through wall.
 	Fixed Kobold Statue level-of-detail meshes.
 	Fixed stray geometry crashing through ceiling in Owl's Head NPC Building.
 	Added a context menu option to clear a locked glyph in the combat hotbar.
 	Female avatar legs no longer disappear if wearing leg armor along with the Short Skirted Satin Bodice.
 	Ornate Elven Longbow shaft is no longer rotated incorrectly when equipped.
 	Walls now block the camera correctly in the Wizard Tower.
 	Founders Cloaks no longer appears all white.
 	Male-avatar hand finger-spacing was updated.
 	Turned shadowcasting off on windows of Greenhouse deco.
 	Playing sheet music from the chat command /play now works properly.
 	Shadow will no longer be rendered while stealthed.
 	Duck models updated.
 	Brown Suede Sofa sitting position was updated to not sit so far forward.
 	Grammar fixes for some task list entries.
 	Ornate Elven Mage staff is now usable as a decoration.
 	Fixed stair ramp colliders in Viking two story stronghold village home.
 	In the Battle of Highvale, Edvard no longer stands as close to the gate (thus fixing conversation issues in some situations)
 	In the Battle of Highvale, Nena's initial request correctly registers as a task.
 	Avatars can once again talk with NPCs that have a required response.
 	Lord Demig is no longer invisible in Caverns of Skrekk.
 	Introduced new guard models for Ferig and Demign
 	NPC in Harvest now holds his staff correctly.
 	Fixed airship wheel that was missing a material in Blood Bay.
 	Fixed an issue where on-and-off states for Geometric Stained Glass Floor Lamps did not affect level-of-detail meshes.
 	Made on-and-off states more obvious for Frosted Glass Floor Lamps.
 	The player is no longer stopped when talking.
 	Carved Oak Furniture recipes are now teachable.
 	Scrolling the camera all the way in no longer blurs the screen.
 	Missing icons for pavers, fountains, and other decorations added.
 	Fixes for some transparent grass.
 	Adjusted a few crafted item values based on ingredient cost.
 	The Obsidian Crown Alchemist merchant in Aerie no longer goes off duty.
 	The Fishing Supply Merchant in Brittany Fields by the docks will no longer run back and forth haphazardly.
 	Most merchants in Brittany Fields now have a small-but-comfortable wander area.
 	Fixed interaction on door in Brittany Sewers.
 	Corrected compass orientation in Brittany Sewers and several other underground scenes.
 	Fixed some ladders sometimes not being able to be traversed by NPCs and pets.
 	Fixed missing Vile Shield mesh.
 	In Harvest, the names of Aldis Adisson and Dagmar, Bjorn's Wife, now correctly update after you learn them.
 	Fixed player being blown through wall from rockslide in Serpent's Spine Mines.
 	Material updates for good equipment.
 	New tiling patterns to enhance materials.
 	Extended the water trigger in Metropolis Island Player Towns to prevent players from falling through the ocean before zoning out via the east exit volume.
 	Corrected location of exit discoveries in Metropolis Mountain Player Towns and removed erroneous south exit discovery.
 	The Cabalists themselves are now personally leading their sieges into battle!
 	Water in Blood River Massacre is no longer invisible.
 	Made corrections to transparency material on tree walls .
 	Missing materials on fences in Spite added.
 	Added missing water into Brookside.
 	Resolution increased for generic fabric and leather textures.

Known Issues:

 	Easter Baskets are invisible during /tossconfettiegg throw emote
 	Not all items listed in R40 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Cover System is not applying to magic spells
 	Some of the Obsidian Cabalist abilities are still placeholder
 	Some NPCs are not holding items correctly (mugs, brooms, etc.)
 	Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	A new Conversation interface has been introduced and may introduce various issues with resolving quests and talking to NPCs.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Lot Deeds cannot be purchased in Offline Mode
 	Some UI text is not wrapping correctly
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies
 	Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.
 	The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.
 	Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.
 	Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body
 	ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT

 	If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.
 	The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.

 	Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body

Deleted a Central Brittany tree that was invading a player lot. 	Fixed some issues that were preventing proper placement of Tall Ivy Covered Stone Fences. 	Removed a duplicated Bell Tower building from Central Brittany. 	Took out extra left arm toss on flowerleap emotes. 	An Upper Fortus ladder is now functional. 	Tooltip performance updated.

notes.title: Release 39 Patch Notes: February 24, 2017
notes.content:
Another game patch has made its way to Release 39! In addition to the patch notes, How to Play instructions on this release are available at shroudoftheavatar's website.

Build Number 563, 7:30 PM CST 	Modified handle on lich axe to be straight so it matches other axes. 	In Blood River, Edvard gives clearer instructions when greeted without a sword. 	Improved flow of journal/task entries in Blood River when Edvard asks you to find the bonesteel dagger. 	Fingers Slate no longer gives incorrect directions in Blood River when greeted without a sword. 	Combat effects now require line of sight in more situations. 	Chaotic Clone now correctly copies the caster's body. 	Umbrella now stays equipped while performing sit emote. 	Trails in VFX will no longer be left behind when the effect ends. 	Ant and Ants cloaks no longer hover over shoulders. 	Unnamed blacksmith supplier in Ardoris now has a proper name. 	Minerva in Aerie no longer wanders into her own cooking fire only to die horribly. 	Simone von Eglinger in Ardoris now properly gives feedback when her quest is finished. 	Emma in Soltown will properly highlight when participating in Japeth's poem quest. 	Fixed inaccurate Points of Interest in Blood River. 	When the Broadcast Automated Phonograph is empty the music now defaults to built-in scene music 	Avatars will no longer turn back around when getting up from chairs. 	Glowing White Dye on Epic Cloth Armor has been toned downed. 	Removed mesh collider from  general bust deco so that it can be placed at any rotation. 	An issue that may have prevented renaming some NPC pets or summons has been corrected. 	Ardoris navmesh updated. 	ChainLighting, Discharge, EarthQuake, Lighting, and Obsidian Arrow have had their damage bonus for Str or Dex moved from being linear to being based on the Sqrt of the value, like most other elements.  The change in math will mean that those with a Strength under 100 for Earth spells or Dexterity under 100 for Air skills will see an increase in damage.  Those with stats over 100 will see diminishing returns on damage bonus. 	Corrected an error with dramatic ambient music not turning off when required. 	Fixed a stuck spot in Upper Fortus. 	Multishot improvements: after significant play testing, multishot is finally getting a much needed rework.  Previously it picked up to 8 targets in the forward arc and each had a 75% chance to get hit by one full damage arrow.  The new version picks up to 8 targets in the forward arc and each will get hit 0-3 arrows, on average, each will get hit by 2 arrows and each will do 75% of melee damage. The net result is on no armor targets, this will double the effective damage.  On high armor targets, this will likely still do significantly more damage.  To compensate for the significant improvement in power of this shot, the cool down time is being moved from 6/12 to 10/20.  Also, Arrow usage chance is now 12 but now Ammo Scavenger chance will apply to help reduce arrows.  Previously it did not. 	Fixed mask on female avatar during Macarena animation to fix upper body. 	Discharge and Lightning sounds linked to sliders. 	Shogun home lights and other SFX added. 	Watcher enemy electricity attack now linked to volume slider. 	Fixed a Central Brittany stuck spot. 	Fine oak furniture updates. 	Made sure Village Lot in Spite was at the proper ground level. 	Healing spells SFX updated. 	The old poison potion will now work as a consumable to poison your weapon.  To use it, just put it in your combat bar or utility bar. 	Added two Chaos resurrection icons along the Upper Fortus river, and added several ladders and stairs in the bandit town to help them navigate their home 	Fixed a minor error with the Upper Foruts elevator. 	Crafted items with material overrides will now render correctly when equipped in the left hand. 	Spawning from lunar rifts now uses the correct animation 	Auto attack will only attack a breakable until it is broken. 	Darkstarr Blood and Clasped Gauntlets cloaks no longer have missing override materials 	Apply pooled experience to Poison Weapon when a Poison Potion is used. 	Brittany Fields bed are no longer out-of-reach. 	Castle Stone Arena Basement and Keep Stone Arena Basement now have lamps in the stairwells and entrances turned on by default. 	A fix for the female avatar magic dance. 	K'Kong stats corrected and giving a more worthy loot bundle. 	Improved combat text performance. 	Stealing from the stall in Kiln will now be considered a crime and adversely affect one's Virtue.

Multishot improvements: after significant play testing, multishot is finally getting a much needed rework.  Previously it picked up to 8 targets in the forward arc and each had a 75% chance to get hit by one full damage arrow.  The new version picks up to 8 targets in the forward arc and each will get hit 0-3 arrows, on average, each will get hit by 2 arrows and each will do 75% of melee damage. The net result is on no armor targets, this will double the effective damage.  On high armor targets, this will likely still do significantly more damage.  To compensate for the significant improvement in power of this shot, the cool down time is being moved from 6/12 to 10/20.  Also, Arrow usage chance is now 12 but now Ammo Scavenger chance will apply to help reduce arrows.  Previously it did not. 	Fixed mask on female avatar during Macarena animation to fix upper body. 	Discharge and Lightning sounds linked to sliders. 	Shogun home lights and other SFX added. 	Watcher enemy electricity attack now linked to volume slider. 	Fixed a Central Brittany stuck spot. 	Fine oak furniture updates. 	Made sure Village Lot in Spite was at the proper ground level. 	Healing spells SFX updated. 	The old poison potion will now work as a consumable to poison your weapon.  To use it, just put it in your combat bar or utility bar. 	Added two Chaos resurrection icons along the Upper Fortus river, and added several ladders and stairs in the bandit town to help them navigate their home 	Fixed a minor error with the Upper Foruts elevator. 	Crafted items with material overrides will now render correctly when equipped in the left hand. 	Spawning from lunar rifts now uses the correct animation 	Auto attack will only attack a breakable until it is broken. 	Darkstarr Blood and Clasped Gauntlets cloaks no longer have missing override materials 	Apply pooled experience to Poison Weapon when a Poison Potion is used. 	Brittany Fields bed are no longer out-of-reach. 	Castle Stone Arena Basement and Keep Stone Arena Basement now have lamps in the stairwells and entrances turned on by default. 	A fix for the female avatar magic dance. 	K'Kong stats corrected and giving a more worthy loot bundle. 	Improved combat text performance. 	Stealing from the stall in Kiln will now be considered a crime and adversely affect one's Virtue.

notes.title: Release 39 Patch Notes: February 24, 2017
notes.content:
Another game patch has made its way to Release 39! In addition to the patch notes, How to Play instructions on this release are available at shroudoftheavatar's website.

Build Number 561, February 24, 2017 at 12:00 PM
Added sound effect to Gated Green Leaf  Box Hedge Fence.
Fixed bug that caused a glyph to get stuck in a slot in the deck building interface.
Fixed an error during equip item via context menu.
Fixed an error during salvage that could occur if multiple salvageable items were placed on the crafting station.
Corpse explosion no longer affects breakable objects.
Updated some weapon icons.
Now using the bounds center rather than adding the y-extent for interactive reticles.
Linked audio with the proper mixers in K’rul.
Fixed issues with the “More…” dialog prompt where it would often display incorrectly. Also, the “More…” dialog prompt no longer blocks input.
Can now progress Path of Love past Crypt of the Avatar if player has Samael in their party and chooses to speak to Miles Shepard instead of Eris.
Fixed issue where targeting some NPCs shows the blue crosshair at their feet.
Fixed seam in the interior of NPC building in Brittany Alleys.
Fixed bad LODs on bell tower in Brittany.
Fixed collision on Ardoris castle stairs to allow for cleaner navmesh baking.
Fixed a typo in concept art rug name.
Made collision shorter on Medium Ivy Covered Stone Fence deco to prevent floating stacked decorations.
Added cutouts in collision of gothic water mansion bridge arches to allow players to swim through them.
Changed name from Roadway to Walkway for new paver recipes.
Fixed a stuck spot on doorways of baron benefactor home.
Fixed colliders on Epic Bamboo cluster decorative tree to make it able to be placed.
Weapon and armor procs no longer initiate global cooldown.
Adjusted LOD ranges on table top elder bush.
Recipe names in the recipe book can now wrap to a second line in order to be more legible.
Reduced the wood rewards from catapult engineers
Fixed gap between wall and doorway frame on front door of the obsidian city sized keep.
Fire VFX now correctly aligned on wands when ignited.
Fixed candle VFX LOD distances – also made candles look better with better performance.
Moved Ardoris Crown Merchant to bank area.
Moved Ardoris blacksmith near crafting pavilion.
Removed dynamic Doe spawners in an Ardoris pond.
Swapped out non-interactive book on counter in Ardoris “New You Salon” for a new one with unique text.
Collision on several Brittany Fields buildings has been updated, allowing beds and other interactives within them to be used.
Fix for patterns in character sheet and on remote players.
Fixed duplicate skill records.
Fixed a spelling mistake in the Pax Ring Artifact description.
Imported correct quill for the “reading” emote on male avatar to align pivot.
Added several lights in K’rul that toggle on when hatch is opened via switch.
Lighting the North Drachvald Spur signal tower’s fire will catch the attention of powerful enemies and draw them to the tower.
Replaced temporary Novia collision along the shore from Ardoris to south of Brightbone Pass with collision that better follows the shoreline.
Changed Player Town name from Silverston to Knight’s Watch.
Preventing patterns from being consumed on reshape failure.
Removed colliders from equipable quill, book, and paper.
Fixing NPC animations during use of instruments.
Lute SFX updated to lower octave.
Updated bagpipes SFX notes and tone.
Fixed floating items in Brittany Fields and architecture poling through gole on a hut.
The “Reclining Figure Relief” decoration now has the correct icon (not a bucket).
Changed the display name of “Cobblestone Roadway Pavers” and “Rough Stone Roadway Pavers” to “Cobblestone Walkway Pavers” and “Rough Stone Walkway Pavers”.
Fixed bugs in Brittany Central involving missing flora, LODs, and seams and gaps in floor pieces in Brittany Castle and Brittany Docks.
Fix for practice dummies not taking damage from attacks.
Weapon icon for Vile Falchion updated.

notes.title: Release 39 Patch Notes: February 23, 2017
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 39! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 39 are available here.

February 23, 2017

Build Number 559, 5:00 PM

Fixes:

 	Modified handle on Lich axe to better fit avatar grip
 	High Tier Elven Mages now drop Elven Staff
 	Fixed an issue with stealthing effects and using the /visible command.
 	Removed duration from Dig In tool tip display
 	Fixed various exceptions
 	Added Post and Rope Water Fence to Water Home Crown Merchant
 	More weapons added to high level enemies including Vile Falchion, Norgard Spatha, Kobold Chain Swords, etc.
 	Recipes for Greco / Roman decorations
 	Fixed naming incosistancy between potion and recipe for Potion of Restoration, Imbued
 	Added "Highlight Quest NPCs" option
 	Fixed an issue with umbrella's open state for remote players.
 	Fixed various sounds that were not connected to the volume controls including wind, crickets, owls, frogs, leaky pipes, running water, water wheels, fire, city noises, swinging signs, looting sound, and tree chopping.
 	Removed no trade flag from R38 raffle tickets
 	Abigail in Soltown will now properly show as an active quest NPC if Charlotte has been saved in Solace Bridge.
 	Fixed an issue with weapon trails showing up when they shouldn't.
 	Fixed collider on K'konng so he can't run through small doors anymore
 	Expired Glyphs lo longer have cooldowns applied. Fixed issue where discarded runes would not get recycled back into the hand.
 	Added short bow to blacksmith in Soltown for quest reasons
 	Gust no longer affects dead characters.
 	Fixed inconsistencies with Guard Abe's dialog in Ardoris
 	Added locked target indicator on nameplates
 	Night vision now correctly modifies the ambient light levels.
 	Summoning a phoenix no longer causes an error.
 	PoT Magic Merchant Female is no longer invisible
 	Create diversity for new roaming shopkeeper clothes - applied new materials with different colors to wealthy merchant prefabs
 	Fixed Poison Weapon skill advancement
 	Beauty pass on poison weapon trail
 	Fire weapon trail fixes
 	Elysian Illumination - fixed problem with rune
 	Elysian Illumination beauty pass - effect no longer resembles a giant cloud of urine
 	Pipe smoke now appears in front of player's head instead of behind
 	Added a recipe to high end loot table.
 	Aerie: Fixed the chairs at (-154.3, 30.7, 262.9) so characters can sit in them.
 	Ardoris: Fixed issues with lovers at (117.4, 53.3, -273.2)
 	Blackblade Foothills, East Vauban Foothills, Northwest Blackblade Mountains, Rumor Peaks, Spectral Peaks, Verdantis Foothills, North Varisalla Foothills: Fixed the climbable rope at (-132.3, 55.3, -165.1) so players can climb all the way up.
 	Brittany Estates: The stool used in the tavern at (150.1, 78.0, 423.8) now seats characters properly.
 	Brittany Fields: Fixed beds that weren't accessible.
 	Brittany Fields: Fixed the collision for the building at (25.7, 42.8, 258.0), and similar buildings in the game, so that NPCs can't pass through the walls. S
 	Changed the Shield of Attraction stats
 	Hilt Fortress: Moved copper ore from (65.2, -44.9, 25.0) to (62.76 -44.788 33.72).
 	Fixed floating crate in North Drachvald Spur
 	K'rawl - Fixed Floating objects.  Added ceiling to a ceilingless chamber. Fixed a hole between rocks in the large blue chamber.
 	Polish Magic Mover UI
 	POT Desert 01 template: fixed issue where NPCs would get stuck in cracks in the docks
 	POT Underground template: Added a fix to block off a "stuck spot" at (268.1, 89.6, -292.0).
 	Ruined Keep, Spindrift Passage, Upper Fortus: Added new mushroom monster spawners
 	Sequanna Colossus: Ensured all compass discoveries are in place and labelled correctly.
 	Show server status as offline when in "Dev Only" mode
 	Soltown Catacombs: Slowed down respawn of all bandits. Added waypoint paths for some spellcasters in the "bandit camp" area. Changed name of "Well-Worn Key" to "Soltown Catacombs Key."
 	Soltown: Harvey, a child in the refugee camp, now has his own bedroll to sleep in at night. Removed weapon rack from (-29.7, 27.1, 4.5).
 	Adjusted floating wall deco in Brittany Estates.
 	Skrekk: fixed collision issue with large rock piece. Adjusted crashing deco objects.
 	Fixed some overly intense bloom settings on alpine weather scenes
 	Superstition Canyon: Partial fix for players being able to attack enemies from below in Superstition canyon.
 	Fixed an overly reflective rock wall material that was noticed as a bug while in the Sequanna Colossus map, but the fix will affect all locations with that asset
 	Material refinements to the Cloud Imperium Airship to compensate for environmental reflections that were recently enabled
 	Shogun Homes: added "Lights On" SFX
 	Added colliders to alien plant visible in Rhun Ruins
 	Improved tooltip for Poison Weapon
 	Fixed NPCs visibly teleporting during schedule changes.
 	Brittany Central: Fixed several stuckpots.
 	Brittany Central: Fixed issues involving seams in architecture, floating props, broken doors, and misplaced props.
 	Fixed watchers not scanning players
 	Clockwork pets: Fixed gears SFX not stopping upon death
 	Fix for NPCs sometimes popping on top of the player during collision.
 	Fix for NPCs not using beds and chairs when instructed.
 	Fixed gigantic table floating above Central Brittany
 	Fixed player vendor, deco automatons, and deco servants t-posing.
 	South Celestial Wetlands: Updated the names for letters and compass POI discoveries in this scene to better represent the local factions.
 	Tower of the Shuttered Eye: Improved the titles of several ambiguously-named letters. Also, all prison benches in the scene are now sittable.
 	Valhold: NPCs should no longer walk through walls in the town's buildings. Also, removed the extra door at (15.9, 85.0, -134.3). Beds in the town should all be usable.
 	Wooden Piers: Fixed a collision issue with a commonly-used pier that should help NPCs walk on them without issue.

Known Issues:

 	Not all items listed in R39 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store
 	Eternal Patterns can be lost when Reshaping. DO NOT USE Eternal Patterns.
 	Cover System is not applying to magic spells
 	You can only see your equipped grayed out tools in your inventory if they were equipped when you loaded into the scene. Any attempt to equip new tools will cause them to appear missing (they won't appear greyed out) until the scene changes.
 	When casting the Charm Animal spell on a mob it will turn it's health bar white/grey and the animal becomes passive, but it's not properly updating the health bar when left clicking the mob as shown below. The health bar on the left is in the animal's passive state but the spell has already worn off, and the spider's name should be in red again.
 	Some Devotionals do not allow for two devotional buffs at the same time

 	Honesty
 	Honor
 	Humility
 	Justice
 	Sacrifice
 	Spirituality
 	Valor


 	Mushroom monster corpses are hard to loot
 	New "More..." convo system is sometimes incorrectly blocking conversations
 	Brittany Fields has some pathfinding issues
 	Some NPCs are not holding items correctly (mugs, brooms, etc.)
 	Cloaks will often sort through the avatar's body
 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.
 	A new Conversation interface has been introduced and may introduce various issues with resolving quests and talking to NPCs.
 	Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.
 	Some spell VFX do not play properly
 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)
 	Hair is not properly working with lighting, fog, etc.
 	Lot Deeds cannot be purchased in Offline Mode
 	AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud
 	Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes
 	Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues
 	Some UI text is not wrapping correctly
 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings
 	Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
 	Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies
 	Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena
 	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
 	If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.
 	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
 	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.
 	The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.
 	Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.
 	Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body
 	ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT

notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 38! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 38 are available here.

February 6, 2017

Build Number 554, 5:30 PM

Fixes:

 	Fixed coconut bra not removing underwear top for female

 	Fixed alchemy station recoginizing obsidian chips as valid ingredient
 	Fixed missing absorption stat from Knight Marshall's Winged Helm
 	Fixed incorrect fizzle chance on Elder Elven Archer Gloves
 	Fixed female firedancer top and leggings not removing underwear

 	Fixed incorrect icon size for many icons
 	Fixed incorrect item description on Potion of Health, Imbued
 	Added milling recipes to carpentry merchants
 	Fixed incorrect names on a few new potion recipes
 	Fixed bug so player can no longer see clockwork dragon's glowing eyes when player is dead.

 	Fixed bug with Ring of Lich Kind not affecting arm skin color with Elven Robes
 	Fixed various issues with Ring of Cuttlekin: Fixed it making all Avatars lightest skin tone on paperdoll. Makes female on character sheet topless. Fixed issue that would hide the Fire Dancer Top.

 	Fixed visual distortion on windows in the shogun row homes.
 	Fixed scale and brightness issues with the prebuild lights in the Shogun homes

 	Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.

 	Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)

 	AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud

 	Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues

 	Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings

 	Local chat is failing in some situations

 	Fixed scale of Black Wings wearable

 	Pickpocket cooldown now decreases with skill level.
 	Round Wide Brimmed Hat is now correctly named "Brown Plague Doctor Hat"

 	Attempted fix on 2-story Obsidian Rowhouse crashing into neighboring rowhouses.
 	New user registration is now direct, and doesn't require getting credentials from email
 	Added pre-built lighting to Shogun Homes.
 	Fixes for Forced Conversation mode getting players stuck in bad state.
 	Shock Monkeys can now be looted if they die with stealth active
 	Icons for the new valentine's day gift boxes are now correct
 	Chained Obsidian Shard can now be placed on floors (inside and on top of buildings)
 	The two Gallows decorations can now be used in Player Owned Towns
 	Yew , Kiln: lowered terrain a bit under Groceries Merchants to prevent their heads from sticking through the stall roofs
 	Xenos: Various framerate and visual fixes

 	Fixed stuck locations
 	Removed half of all grass in all areas
 	Added butterfly VFX
 	Restored correct materials to 3 greco roman statues
 	LODs for greco-roman statuary
 	Fixed statue LOD popping in xenos

notes.title: Release 38 Patch Notes: January 26, 2017
notes.content:
Release 38
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 38! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 38 are available here.

January 26, 2017

Build Number 543, 5:00 PM

Fixes:

 	Xenos: Fixed various issues around Xenos including:

 	Brought bedroll back down to earth.
 	Fixed some breakable vases that were not reachable
 	Fixed a tent that players were getting stuck in
 	Added/improved signage for shops along perimeter of central stage/plaza, including some tooltip customization; also added a few weapon racks outside combat shop.
 	Added a few additional discoveries to scene.
 	Terrain edge and seam paint pass


 	Novia Overworld:

 	Updated travel speed for roads near (-423.9, 13.6, -62.2) and (-420.3, 12.9, -68.4).
 	Added box collider around the Tower of the Shuttered Eye so players cannot wiggle up the side of it.
 	Raised the sailing boats by a small amount to help avoid ocean water splashing through the hull.
 	Fixed a typo in the spelling of "Port Graff" in its Discovery location.
 	Restored access to the South Varisalla Foothills


 	Blood Bay:

 	Lava polish
 	Fixed collision that was too big on the trees in the swamps
 	Adjusted locations of enemy spawners and player spawn-in targets to reduce chances of players being attacked while spawning into the scene.
 	Adjusted LOD distances for some of the taller buildings in the town
 	Fixed missing effect icons found in Blood Bay (Fire Damage and Confusion Field)
 	Added missing flora
 	Fixed stuck spots
 	Added a Stealth Field


 	Fixed LODs on Cinereous Stone 2 tier fountain
 	Adjusted exterior of 2-story Obsidian Rowhouse to prevent crashing with neighboring rowhouses.
 	Fixed issue where player corpses would stand back up after dying while under the Knock Down effect
 	Obsidian Crown merchants no longer discuss potions.
 	Added 2017 Valentine's Gift Boxes and 2017 Valentine's Card to the game
 	Fixed distances on avatar sitting animations so they sit correctly in chairs.
 	Added some additional logging
 	Updated in game events and known issues books to be R38
 	Updated some materials on the Pirate Galleon and made various other fixes
 	No longer can you rudely do business with bankers, merchants and trainers while clapping coconuts in their face. The reign of coconut terror is OVER.
 	Soltown: Blacksmith now properly exits conversation when off duty
 	Fixed issue where baby clockwork dragons were flapping their wings too fast when landing and taking off
 	Modified cull distance on Oracle Confirmatory eyes so they don't disappear before the building does
 	Fixed issue where melee combat attacks would disrupt mouse movement controls
 	Regeneration potions will now last a full 10 minutes.
 	Fixed bugs with craftable Shogun 1 Room Bungalow
 	Updated male and female walk cycles including walk backwards. Also added new encumbered animation.
 	Fixed Masterwork bug that prevented an item from being Masterworked more than 3 times
 	Tower of the Shuttered Eye: Adjusted Awareness and Help radii for all basic enemies and now they won't dogpile on players going up the stairs.
 	Fixed bodices not removing underwear
 	Naryad Moors: All garlic resource nodes are once again correct size and not overly large.
 	Fixed various issues with the Shogun Lighthouse Village Home
 	Added recipes for the Perennial Coast Farmer and Peasant Outfits
 	Fixed Equipment not receiving durability bonus displayed and expected
 	Set Masterwork Grandmaster Durability item bonus to be static (30 bonus durability) versus variable
 	Fixed LOD issues on craftable fountain
 	Fixed incorrect durability on Shogun Armor helm
 	Ardoris: Re-positioned barrels at this location and swapped one out for indestructible version. Loc: (-274.7, 84.9, -99.4)
 	Website: New landing page and new background
 	Fixed issue where arrows were firing half a foot away from the left shoulder instead of from the bow
 	Ardoris: Fixed broken ladders in guard towers. Fixed missing collision on walls of bridges leading into the city
 	Vertas Pass: All cotton resource nodes are now scaled to proper proprotions.
 	Dreadlocks hairstyle should now properly display hair color (not so dull)
 	South Celestial Wetlands and North Celestial Wetlands: Spiked-skull markers are once again present at each exit archway.
 	Fixed broken Aerie Merchants
 	Fixed issue where Grandmaster Buffs remain applied to party members even when GM logs out
 	Harvest: The Housing Deeds Merchant at (130.8, 38.1, 162.0) no longer wanders.
 	Fizzle bonuses were being applied inconsistently for staves/wands vs open hand due to an order of operations issue in the math.  The math has now been corrected and they should now be consistent but the result is players will likely see a change a change in total fizzle chance. Since we had to change the math for fizzle we also fixed a few lingering issues. 2 handed weapons were only counting as one for fizzle chances. They will now count as 2 full hands. The empty hand bonus was reduced to 10% (from 15%) per hand. Wands are still 15% bonus in either hand and staves are 30% fizzle bonus. The result is players who were wielding 2 handed weapons will see about 10-20% increase in fizzle chance for spells depending on the school.
 	Fixed issue in Soltown Catacombs where enemies could be Gusted through walls.
 	Superstition Canyon: The tree at (299.8, 56.6, 230.9) is now sitting properly at ground level. Elementals near (225.5, 51.9, 316.6) are no longer spawning within the rocks.
 	Nightshade Pass: Cleaned up shrubs in area and fixed ladder at Loc: (-19.5, 64.3, 215.9). Removed problematic fishing hotspot at (35.7, 19.3, 16.0).
 	Changed the name of the Poi Dog Statues to Foo dogs
 	Fixed various issues with the Shogun City Keep
 	Fixed bug where the Ghost corpse was not visible when killed and could be seen upright and alive when rezoning.
 	Fixed stuck spot in Vauban Pass )
 	West Perennial Trail: Grounded floating letter at this location. Loc: (-74.9, 33.5, -44.2)
 	Made a few skinning tweaks to Clockwork Dragon.
 	Fixed issue with decorations not being able to be placed in various locations of the 2-story Obsidian Rowhouse
 	Fixed problems with baby clockwork dragons VFX not showing up correctly
 	Fixed an issue where players would spawn into certain maps floating in the air
 	Adjusted pet collider sizes to improve pathing so hopefully they will get stuck less
 	Adjusted colliders on various wall decos to enable more consistent displaying of tooltips.
 	Adjusted collision on 3-story bamboo cluster deco.
 	Resolute Sewers: Turned off treasure chest functionality on several crates to allow access to resource nodes within.
 	Savrenoc Stronghold: Moved nodes to better locations. Loc: (-235.7, 35.8, -184.4)
 	Fixed empty merchant in Ferigs battle camp
 	Improved perimeter details in Forest 01 POT Templates
 	Fixed practice dummy LODs
 	Shogun Crown Merchant Updates: Blue Tile Roof row homes replaced with the new Shogun Row Homes, Two new Foo Dog Statues added, Existing Foo Dog statue lowered in price (10), Added Potted Bamboo 3-Pack, Added Ornate Shogun Room Dividers
 	POT Aelasar's Forest: Upgraded to Village.
 	Fixed issue where swimming with the Firedancer outfit would make the avatar appear naked
 	Fixed various bugs with Shogun Rowhouses.
 	Earthquake now has visible VFX again
 	Fixed Ardoris Priestess robes and headpiece icons
 	Fixed various exceptions
 	Playing the phonograph now properly fades down scene music
 	Fixed Bone Armor icons
 	Kingsport: There were actually 3 NPCs using the same path, the third being a non-lamp-lighting guard. Split the path into 3 separate segments and assigned each NPC their own. Also added lamplighter schedule to guard, because why not?
 	North Ravenswood: Moved skeleton near (-160.7, 27.6, -139.8)  away from the nearby tree to help keep him from spawning within the tree.
 	Fixed bug where Rend (Blades) created two DoT stacks on a single hit.
 	Changed Pirate Galleon crown price (350->300)
 	Fixed location of multi-selection item count when selecting items
 	Blood River: Edvard's "unlock" keyword hint made more obvious.
 	Solania: Mark the craft supplier properly ends conversation when player says goodbye.
 	Redmill no longer has two town criers, but instead has a town crier which no longer acts as a banker and a separate banker similar to other player run towns.
 	Fixed short and long skirted bodices not removing underwear
 	Fixed issues with the ornate wooden street lantern.
 	Elementals will now also do some amount of hand to hand damage along with their elemental damage. This should fix exploitable issues with using Elemental pets to distract wild Elementals.
 	Fixed issue where players already sitting/dancing in a scene when you join will appear to only be standing idle instead
 	Added more magical artifacts! Go find them!
 	Fixed issue with ranged auto-attack projectile being very, very slow
 	Fixed bankers not opening the bank
 	Added a few quacks on Duck anim tracks.
 	Zombie Raven Sound Added
 	Wisp Sounds and Catapult sounds sfx
 	Remote bank access device display name updated (from "Bank Access Device" to "Remote Bank Access Device")
 	Added Dye Remover to Obsidian Potion Crown Merchant: 12 pack for 8 gold cotos
 	Fixed missing textures and scale issues on copper baby clockwork dragon
 	Jabbering Bertha's name appears correctly when heckling.
 	Fixed Clockwork Dragon disappearing on death
 	POT Templates: Grasslands 01, 01a,  Forest 02: Increased flat areas in several locations for more easily placed castle lots. I left a subtle little patch of dirt on both ends of each intended lot space to help guide in placement.
 	Fixed male Firedancer outfit not removing underwear, woohoo
 	North Midmaer Way, North Hulenholt, South Naryad Pinelands, Solace Forest, Ulfheim: For Ulfheim and all related clones, fixed issue where Bear Patriarch was spawning inside rocks.
 	Fixed a typo in the description of the potion of might
 	Improved Earthquake VFX
 	Crag Foothills: Moved stag spawners to prevent the stags getting stuck in rocks
 	Fixed various issues with moving platforms related to not seeing other players properly
 	Fixed damage calculation on tooltips.
 	Fixed issue where Ground Pound range increased with skill level, but not reflected in range of targets hit

Known Issues:

 	Facial Hair transparency is showing big opaque squares ironically
 	Some Add On Store items listed in the Release Instructions post are not yet available (Dry Docked Pirate Galleon, Squirrel Pets, Baby Clockwork Dragon Pets, Ornate Circlet, etc.)

 	AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud
 	Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes
 	Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues
 	Some UI text is not wrapping correctly

notes.title: Release 38 Instructions
notes.content:
WARNING: THIS GAME IS EARLY ACCESS. PLEASE DO NOT PURCHASE IT UNLESS YOU WANT TO ACTIVELY SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF THE GAME VIA CROWD FUNDING, BUG TESTING, AND FEEDBACK. PLEASE ONLY PURCHASE IF YOU ARE ALSO PREPARED TO HANDLE PERIODIC WIPES, SERIOUS ISSUES AND INCOMPLETE CONTENT. PLEASE READ THE NEGATIVE REVIEWS PRIOR TO PURCHASE, MANY OF WHICH WARN YOU OF THE CURRENT UNFINISHED STATE OF THE GAME. 

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/r38_instructions_lead_image_v3.jpg

Avatars,

Please read this entire message, as well as the linked instructions and known issues.

Release 38 is one of our larger releases because some of the work was started before the holiday break and some of the content has been worked on for several releases (Xenos, Blood Bay, Scaled Crafting).

Perennial Coast Improvements (Architecture/Flora): In Release 38, we are moving through all the scenes along the Perennial Coast and updating the flora and architecture to match the new Asian influence we first showed in Ardoris during Release 37. This includes replacing all the exit arches, adding in more bamboo (along with other flora), adding or swapping out Asian architectural elements, along with other details. The only scene we are not touching in R38 is Celestis, which is getting its own specific un-cloning task in a future release.

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Perennial-Coast-4.jpg

Perennial Coast Improvements (Character): All NPCs along the Perennial Coast are now using custom regional Asian influenced outfits including the Guards, Citizens, Farmers, Merchants, and Nobility. Additionally all Guards along the Perennial Coast are now equipped with Katanas. This, of course, includes Ardoris itself.

Solania: The small town of Solania is located in the Perennial Coast region in the southeast of Novia. Solania is located on a high point in the Celestial Swamp that lines the southern shore of Celestial Lake, so getting there can be quite dangerous. Like the other Perennial Coast scenes, Solania got a polish pass to incorporate the Asian influence. This included updating all of the NPC buildings with new rooflines (blue tiles) and wall textures, putting in a new perimeter Shogun style wall, updating the foliage, and adding in various other details. As with all polish and un-clone passes we make on maps we do NOT change lot placements. We only make cosmetic changes of building styles, terrain, and foliage.

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Solania5.jpg

Brookside: Brookside is located in the Drachvald region in the northeast of Novia directly south of Spite. It is the hometown of Samael and was overrun by the Undead armies of Anapa not long ago. Starting with Release 38, players will encounter this town when following their quests along the Path of Love. Brookside started as a cloned scene using one of our PRT/POT templates based off of the Forest 02 POT template (a forested variation of the Grasslands POT template). In Release 38, it is was rebuilt with new flora, new atmospheric settings like permanent fog, a graveyard, and other unique features for the plot including Samael’s farm. Note that when we un-clone these scenes, we do NOT change lot placements. We only make cosmetic changes of building styles, terrain, and foliage.

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Brookside7.jpg

Highvale Polish: Various changes were made to this starting scene on the Path of Courage. The scene in general has been given a level of polish with the addition of many more difficulty-appropriate monsters in previously unused areas, fixing of outstanding bugs, fixing pathing errors, etc., so that it is comparable to the other two tutorial areas. A new optional quest has been added to the tutorial as well—visit the central keep to begin.

Courage Path Polish: Various changes were made to the Path of Courage. In addition to other bugs addressed with quests in Resolute and post-tutorial Highvale, players who were unable to progress the Path of Courage due to a certain uncommunicative NPC within Valhold Keep will find the path open to them now.

Vauban Pass: Vauban Pass is one of the numerous Control Points that limits travel between regions in Novia. It is located between the Grunvald and Drachvald regions and is controlled by the Undead armies of Anapa. Vauban Pass started as a clone of Sanctus Spine but now has been completely rebuilt for Release 38; making all the Control Points unique scenes.

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Vauban-Pass-1.jpg

Xenos: Right before we went persistent, we uncloned Xenos and made some modifications to it for specific plot points. However, we were not satisfied with the level of polish, so we chose to do a major rebuild of this scene to bring it up to the quality it needed to be at. Xenos is on the island of Elysium, southwest of Novia, and is a critical juncture on the Path of Truth. The modifications focused on bringing out the Greco-Roman character of the region as well as highlighting the various aspects of the Lottery of Artifice—including pilgrim encampments, an ancient caravanserai, and the temple of Boreas. We also greatly expanded the aqueduct system, rebuilt the dock area, and added a Lagoon of Pleasures.

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Xenos-Subpost-V_13.jpg

Blood Bay: Blood Bay is a tropical island that was smashed by shards of the moons during the Cataclysm. These shards triggered a massive volcanic event that is still happening today. Toxic minerals in the lava have stained the water red, giving the island its distinctive name. Obsidian Shards in the area make the Protection of the Oracle impossible, making the entire island an Open PvP zone where Outlanders slaughter each other at will. Due to the incredibly unstable nature of the island, only the most desperate and dangerous individuals dare live there: Pirates, Brigands, Thieves, etc. In response, some others who follow a more virtuous path have taken it upon themselves also reside here to keep a watchful eye on the miscreants of the island. Both groups have formed their own settlements on the highest cliffs opposite the volcano above the bay. These two settlements represent opposite ends of the spectrum of virtue and are known as Scoundrel’s Hold and Judge’s Watch, respectively. In future releases if your virtue is high, the townspeople of Judge’s Watch will interact with you, but if your virtue is low, they will refuse to have any business with you. The opposite will be true for Scoundrel’s Hold, where they will only interact with you if your virtue is low. For R38, the NPCs work just like other towns and the virtue mechanic does not yet factor in. Outside the towns, the island is filled with dangerous beasts and a landscape just as dangerous, filled with quicksand (slows you down), fields of poison gas, magic-boosting shards, magic nullifying shards, fields of confusion, and other hazards. This map is a testing ground for many of these new systems, features and ideas that we will then propagate out to other maps over the next several releases. Player housing is not yet available in Blood Bay but should be available in the next few releases.

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/SotA_BloodBay_5.jpg

Canyon Siege: We created another scene for use in the Town Sieges. This scene is a bridge across a canyon for use in towns near mountainous areas.

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Canyon-Siege-1.jpg

Control Points: Mages in control points now have spells that manipulate player position (much like the Daemon). Additionally, during the final wave there is a small chance a boss-level NPC will show up, of a type appropriate for the NPCs of that control point.

Non-Hostile Overworld Encounters: Roving Encounters on the Overworld now have the ability to be flagged as Non-Hostile. We can use this flag for prey animals like Deer or domestic animals like Sheep as well as wandering merchants (when we add that encounter). This means that these particular encounters will no longer attack you on sight (we are very sorry if you enjoyed being chased by aggressive deer).

Traps and Puzzles: We have implemented a set of new traps and puzzles for the game. Release 38 will include Pressure Plates (these can open doors as well as trigger traps), Flame Jets, Arrow Shooters, and updated versions of the old Spike Traps. We will begin propagating these throughout the game over the next several releases. In R38, you can find Arrow Shooters and Flame Jets in the Brittany Sewers.

Keys & Locks: As you adventure throughout Novia and the Hidden Vale, you'll find that many keys now have a chance to break on each use. Keys may have a good chance to break (such as the keys for the locked passages that interconnect underground scenes and the cages found in wilderness scenes throughout Novia), while others break about half the time (such as the key for the Kiln Cistern Alchemist's Workshop), and some will never break (such as special keys required for quests).

Moving Platforms: We now have the ability to move players on platforms for things like elevators, mine carts, etc. Our first example is an airship patrol of Blood Bay. We will be adding many more examples in upcoming releases.

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Blood-Bay-30.jpg

New NPC Conversation Interface: We have updated the conversation window used for interacting with NPCs to make it both more immersive and easier to use. For immersion, we are hiding almost all of the other interface elements, including all other chat and the hotbar. We are also placing the chat in the very middle of the screen where you are looking at the NPC in order to keep you focused on the interaction. We have also tried to keep the interface itself as minimal as possible, with very few borders and as much transparency in the elements as we can. For ease of use, we are placing all the keywords in a toolbar at the bottom of the window. This toolbar will include every keyword you have uncovered with the NPC, including keywords relating to quests you are currently on and keywords learned from past conversations with that NPC. This saves you from having to scroll back to find keywords you might not remember. Players who preferred the older text-based conversation interface will find that still works as well, and in some cases will discover hidden secrets. 

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/NPC-convo-UI-with-spaces-and-name-colors.jpg

Scaling Masterworking and Enchanting: The higher your skill level in Masterworking and Enchanting the higher the power of the effect you add.

Proportional Masterworking and Enchanting: The power of the effect added is now directly proportional to how many levels of masterworking/enchanting have been applied to better balance risk versus reward. So the power of the first effect added is much weaker than the sixth effect added.

Weapons and Armor Enchanting Skills: There are now two specialization skills in Enchanting: Weapons and Armor. You will need to level these up in order to gain access to higher level enchantments (aka Major Enchants). The addition of these is to further our efforts to rewards specialization in crafting.

Grandmaster Masterworking Maximum Durability: If you are a Grandmaster at Masterworking, you have a chance to add Maximum Durability back to the item you are working on instead of adding an effect.

Grandmaster Enchanting Durability Hardening: Grandmaster Enchanters now have the ability to add an enchantment that hardens weapons and armor against durability reduction.

Attunement and Resistance Enchantments: There are now attunement (weapons) and resistance (chest armor) available to enchanters where the effects are tied to the gem used.

Food Buffs in Combat: Buffs and bonuses from food now work during combat as well as out of combat.

Bone Armor: Bone Armor has been greatly increased in power. As a reminder, Bone Armor is classified as Light Armor but offers a level of protection similar to Plate while still being very light in weight and low in Fizzle. For R38, we increased the Damage Avoidance, increased Durability, and added some Damage Resistance.

Obsidian Armor and Weapons: Obsidian Armor and Weapons have been greatly increased in power as well. Both weapons and armor have had their maximum durability raised to match other gear and had their weight reduced. Armor also had its Fizzle chance reduced greatly and Damage Resistance was increased. As a reminder, Obsidian Armor comes with a damage reflection bonus and Obsidian weapons have a high critical damage chance.

Over 20 New Crafting Recipes: Including torches, Perennial Coast Outfits, Circlets, and new combat potions.

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Perrenial-Coast-Peasant-Outfits.png

Clockwork Dragon: Kobold scientists at the K’rul (Kobold Research Underground Lab) unleashed these gigantic mechanical terrors on Novia to invoke panic among humans. Their program appears to be succeeding… You can find one in Blood Bay, if you dare.

//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/SS_Clockworkdragon_J.jpg

Shock Monkey: Shock Monkeys are another mechanical nightmare from K’rul, developed for covert missions. These mechanical monkeys are a terrible version of their cute organ grinder cousins, with sharp claws and teeth plus a shocking electrical attack. They also have stealth abilities that allow them to completely disappear from view. They are rumored to have been found in Skrekk, Blood Bay, Sanctus Spine, and a few other location in Novia.

NPC Preferential Targeting: We now have the ability to set preferences on creatures for which kinds of targets they prefer. Starting with Slimes who prefer metallic targets (players wearing metal armor) and Flesh Flayers who prefer fleshier targets (players wearing cloth and leather).

NPC Stealth: Creatures now have the ability to go into stealth mode like players. The first creature to take advantage of this ability is the Shock Monkey (see above).

NPCs Attack While Rooted: NPCs will now continue to attack while rooted (just like players).

New Potions: Including Healing and Focus Potions of various strengths, stat boosts, regeneration boosts, and resistance boosts.

Rare Loot: Players can now find rare Artifacts (non-craftable magical items) as loot on high level creatures they fight. They can also find recipes starting with the new potions we created this release (more recipes will follow). Here's a brief list of some of these artifacts: 

    Ring of Brittle Brawn: Reduces hit points by 40% but adds significant (20-50) strength.
    Ring of the Frogkin: When worn you are able to jump slightly higher. However your skin turns green.
    Torch of Jerik: This large iron basket torch can be wielded as a mace.
    Belt of the Ox: Cuts your move speed in half but quadruples carrying capacity.
    Ring of Luck: Gives a small wishing well bonus.
    Slipshod Shooter's Sash: This belt gives a bonus to your Rapidfire skill, gives a small bonus to Rapidfire power, but decreases your Ammo Scavenger.  So you can shoot more arrows but you lose more arrows…
    Lavalliere of the Lagomorph: This necklace of the rabbit greatly decreases your strength but increases your movement and attack speed.


 And much more including more player outfits, tons of bug fixes, new pets, inventory and UI polish, combat balance, etc.! Click here for the complete R38 Instructions

 [And did we mention that you should read the negative reviews that warn you about the unfinished state of this game before you purchase? Don't buy this game until you read them!]
